a: Umuttar bah miyyad.
Amar rava: may tama derabbi shimon ben elazar — dichtiv: "kol eved ish miknat kasef". "eved ish", velo eved ishsha? ella "eved ish" — atta mal beal korcho, vei atta mal ben ish beal korcho.
Verabbanan? amar ulla: keshem shei atta mal ben ish beal korcho, kach i atta mal eved ish beal korcho. veella hachtiv "kol eved ish"? hahu mibbee leh lichdishmuel.

Deamar shemuel: hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut veen tzarich get shichrur, shenneemar: "kol eved ish miknat kasef". "eved ish", velo eved ishsha? ella: eved sheyyesh lo reshut lerabbo alav — karuy eved, vesheen reshut lerabbo alav — en karuy eved.
Matkef la rav pappa: emor deshamat lehu lerabbanan bifat toar, dela shayycha bemitzvot. aval eved, deshayech bemitzvot, hachi name daafillu rabbanan modu.
Detanya: echad ger veechad lokeach eved min haggoy — tzarich lekabbel. ha lokeach miyyisrael — en tzarich lekabbel.

Manni? i rabbi shimon ben elazar, haamar: lokeach min haggoy name en tzarich lekabbel! ella lav rabbanan, ushema minna: delokeach min haggoy — tzarich lekabbel, aval lokeach miyyisrael — en tzarich lekabbel.
Veella kashya echad ger veechad eved meshucherar! ki tanya hahi — leinyan tevila tanya.
Tanu rabbanan: "vegillecha et roshah veasta et tzipporneha", rabbi eliezer omer: takotz, rabbi akiva omer: tegaddel.

Amar rabbi eliezer: neemra asiyya barosh, veneemra asiyya batztzippornayim. ma lehallan haavara — af kan haavara. rabbi akiva omer: neemra[5] asiyya barosh, veneemra[5] asiyya batztzippornayim. ma lehallan niuul — af kan niuul.
Ureaya ledivre rabbi eliezer: "umefivoshet ben shaul yarad likrat hammelech lo asa raglav velo asa sefamo", may asiyya — haavara.
Tanu rabbanan: "uvachta et aviha veet immah",
b: Rabbi eliezer omer: "aviha" — aviha mammash, "immah" — immah mammash. rabbi akiva omer: "aviha veimmah" — zo avoda zara. vechen hu omer: "omrim laetz avi atta vegomer".
"Yerach yamim" — yerach sheloshim yom. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, tishim yom: "yerach" — sheloshim, "yamim" — sheloshim, "veachar ken" — sheloshim.
Matkef la ravina: ema: "yerach" — sheloshim, "yamim" — sheloshim, "veachar ken" — ki hane? kashya.

Tanu rabbanan: mekayyeymin avadim sheenam malin, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: en mekayyeymin. amar lo rabbi yishmael, hare hu omer: "veyinnafesh ben amatcha"! amar lo: belokeach eved ben hashshemashot velo hispik lemulo hakkatuv medabber.

Dechulle alma mihat "veyinnafesh ben amatcha" — beeved arel ketiv, may mashma? detanya: "veyinnafesh ben amatcha" — beeved arel hakkatuv medabber. atta omer beeved arel, o eno ella beeved mahul? keshehu omer "lemaan yanuach avdecha vaamatcha kamocha", hare eved mahul amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "veyinnafesh ben amatcha" — beeved arel.
"Vehagger" — ze ger toshav. atta omer ze ger toshav, o eno ella ger tzedek? keshehu omer "vegercha asher bisharecha", hare ger tzedek amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "vehagger" — ze ger toshav.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hallokeach eved min haggoy velo ratza lamul — megalgel immo ad shenem asar chodesh. lo mal — chozer umochro legoyim.

Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa, keman — dela kerabbi akiva. dei rabbi akiva, haamar: en mekayyeymin! amar lehu rav pappa: afillu tema rabbi akiva, hane mille hecha dela paska lemilleteh, aval hecha defaska lemilleteh — paska.
Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, amar li: i hachi, ki amar leh rabbi akiva belokeach eved ben hashshemashot, lishanne leh ha! chada mittere tame kaamar.

Shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi ilay, vechol rabbotay amru li mishshemo: ezehu eved arel shemmuttar lekayyeymo — ze shellekacho rabbo al menat shello lemulo. amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa: keman? dela kerabbi akiva, dei rabbi akiva, haamar: en mekayyeymin! amar lehu rav pappa: afillu tema rabbi akiva, hane mille hecha dela atni bahadeh, aval hecha deatni — atni.
Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, vaamar li: i hachi, ki kaamar leh rabbi akiva belokeach eved ben hashshemashot velo hispik lemulo — lishanne leh ha!
Velitamaych, lishanne leh hach! ella, chad mittere utelat tame kaamar.

Yetev rabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha akkila derabbi yitzchak nappacha, veyatvi vekaamri: ir achat hayta beeretz yisrael velo ratzu avadeha lamul, vegilgelu immahem ad shenem asar chodesh, vechazru umecharum legoyim. keman —

Ki hay tanna, detanya: hallokeach eved min haggoy velo ratza lamul — megalgel immo ad shenem asar chodesh, lo mal — chozer umochro legoyim. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: en meshahin oto beeretz yisrael, mippene hefsed teharot. uvair hassemucha lassefar en meshahin oto kol ikkar, shemma yishma davar veyelech veyomar lachavero goy.

Tanya, rabbi chananya beno shel rabban gamliel omer: mippene ma gerim bizman hazze meunnin, veyissurin bain alehen — mippene shello kiyyeymu sheva mitzvot bene noach. rabbi yose omer: ger shennitgayyer — kekatan shennolad dame. ella mippene ma meunnin — lefi sheen bekiin bedikduke mitzvot keyisrael. abba chanan omer mishshum rabbi elazar: lefi sheen osin meahava, ella miyyira.

Acherim omrim: mippene sheshshihu atzmam lehikkanes tachat kanfe hashshechina. amar rabbi avahu, veittema rabbi chanina, may keraa: "yeshallem Adonai poolech utehi maskurtech shelema meim Adonai elohe yisrael asher bat lachasot vegomer".

a: Mishna ezehu mamzer — kol sheer basar shehu belo yavo", divre rabbi akiva. shimon hattimni omer: kol shechayyayvim alav karet bide shamayim, vahalacha kidvarav. verabbi yehoshua omer: kol shechayyayvin alav mitat bet din.
Amar rabbi shimon ben azzay: matzati megillat yuchasin birushalayim, vechatuv bah: ish peloni mamzer meeshet ish, lekayyem divre rabbi yehoshua.

Ishto shemmeta — muttar baachotah. gershah umeta — muttar baachotah. nisset leacher umeta — muttar baachotah. yevimto shemmeta — muttar baachotah. chalatz lah umeta — muttar baachotah. nisset leacher umeta — muttar baachotah.
Gemara may tama derabbi akiva? dichtiv: "lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle kenaf aviv". kanaf sheraa aviv — lo yegalle.
Vesavar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: baanusat aviv hakkatuv medabber, dehavya la chayyayve lavin,
Usemich leh: "lo yavo mamzer bikhal Adonai", alma mehane have mamzer.
Ulerabbi simay, dimrabbe shear chayyayve lavin delav disher", ulerabbi yeshevav, dimrabbe afillu chayyayve ase —
Nafka lehu mivvelo".
Veshimon hattimni savar la kerabbanan, deamri: beshomeret yavam shel aviv hakkatuv medabber, dehavya la chayyayve karetot, usemich leh "lo yavo mamzer". alma: mechayyayve karetot have mamzer.
Verabbi yehoshua — lichtov rachamana "lo yegalle". "lo yikkach" ("velo yegalle") lema li? ella lav, hachi kaamar: millo yikkach" ad "lo yegalle" — have mamzer, tefe — la have mamzer.
Amar abbaye: hakkol modim beva al hannidda
b: Veal hassota — sheen havvalad mamzer.
Nidda, deha tafsi ba kiddushin, shenneemar: "utehi niddatah alav", afillu bishat niddatah tafsi ba kiddushin.
Sota name, deha tafsi ba kiddushin.
Tanya name hachi: hakkol modim beva al hannidda veal hassota veal shomeret yavam, sheen havvalad mamzer.
Veabbaye, shomeret yavam — mesappeka leh i kerav i kishmuel.

Amar rabbi shimon ben azzay kulei. tane, shimon ben azzay omer: matzati megillat yuchasin birushalayim, vechatuv bah: ish peloni mamzer meeshet ish, vechatuv bah: mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kav venaki. vechatuv bah: menashshe harag et yeshaya.

Amar rava: medan dayyneh vekatleh. amar leh, moshe rabbecha amar: "ki lo yirani haadam vachay", veat amrat: "vaere et Adonai yoshev al kisse ram venissa". moshe rabbecha amar: "mi chaAdonai elohenu bechol korenu elav", veat amrat: "dirshu Adonai behimmatzo". moshe rabbecha amar: "et mispar yamecha amalle", veat amrat: "vehosafti al yamecha chamesh esre shana"!

Amar yeshaya: yadana beh dela mekabbel ma deema leh, vei ema leh — eshshavveyeh mezid. amar shem ibbela bearza, atyu learza venasseru. ki meta lahade pumma, nach nafsheh. mishshum daamar: "uvetoch am teme sefatayim anochi yoshev".
Mikkol makom kashu kerae ahadade?
"Vaere et Adonai", kidtanya: kol hanneviim nistakkelu beaspaklarya sheenah meira, moshe rabbenu nistakkel beaspaklarya hammeira.
"Dirshu Adonai behimmatzo" — ha beyachid, ha betzibbur. veyachid emat? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: ellu asara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim.
"Et mispar yamecha amalle" — tannae hi, detanya: "et mispar yamecha amalle",

a: Ellu shene dorot. zacha — mashlimin lo, lo zacha — pochatin lo, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: zacha — mosifim lo, lo zacha — pochatin lo.

Amru lo lerabbi akiva, hare hu omer: "vehosafti al yamecha chamesh esre shana"! amar lahem: mishshello hosifu lo. teda, shehare navi omed umitnabbe "hinne ven nolad levet david yoshiyyahu shemo", vaadayin lo nolad menashshe!
Verabbanan — mi ketiv mechizkiyya? "levet david" ketiv, i mechizkiyya nolad, i meinash acharina.
Ishto shemmeta vechulei yevimto shemmeta vechulei. amar rav yosef: kan shana rabbi mishna sheenah tzericha.
Hadaran alach hacholetz

Rabban gamliel omer: en get achar get, velo maamar achar maamar, velo beila achar beila, velo chalitza achar chalitza. vachachamim omrim: yesh get achar get, veyesh maamar achar maamar. aval lo achar beila, velo achar chalitza kelum.
Ketzad: asa maamar bivimto venatan lah get — tzericha hemennu chalitza. asa maamar vachalitza — tzericha hemennu get. asa maamar uvaal — hare zo kemitzvatah.
Natan get veasa maamar — tzericha get vachalitza. natan get uvaal — tzericha get vachalitza. natan get vechalatz — en achar chalitza kelum.
Chalatz veasa maamar, natan get uvaal, o baal veasa maamar, natan get vechalatz — en achar chalitza kelum.
b: Echad yevama achat leyavam echad, veechad shete yevamot leyavam echad. ketzad? asa maamar bazo umaamar bazo — tzerichot shene gittin vachalitza. maamar bazo veget lazo — tzericha get vachalitza. maamar bazo uvaal et zo — tzerichot shene gittin vachalitza. maamar bazo vechalatz lazo — harishona tzericha get.
Get lazo veget lazo — tzerichot hemennu chalitza. get lazo uvaal et zo — tzericha get vachalitza. get lazo umaamar bazo — tzericha get vachalitza. get lazo vechalatz lezo — en achar chalitza kelum.

Chalatz vechalatz, o chalatz veasa maamar, natan get uvaal, o baal uvaal, o baal veasa maamar, natan get vechalatz — en achar chalitza kelum. ben yavam echad lishte yevamot, ben shene yevamin livama achat.
Chalatz veasa maamar, natan get uvaal, o baal veasa maamar, venatan get vechalatz — en achar chalitza kelum. ben battechilla, ben baemtza, ben bassof.

Vehabbeila, bizman shehi battechilla — en achareha kelum, baemtza uvassof — yesh achareha kelum. rabbi nechemya omer: achat beila veachat chalitza, ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof — en achareha kelum.
Gemara ad kan la peligi ella beget achar get, umaamar achar maamar. aval get echad bivama [umaamar echad bivama] — mahane.

May tama amur rabbanan get bivama mahane — mishshum demahane bealma. dei amrat la mahane, amri: get lehotziah, vachalitza lehotziah. umiddeget la mahane — chalitza name la mahane, veate lemival achar chalitza.
Umay tama amur rabbanan maamar bivama mahane — mishshum demahane bealma. dei amrat la mahane, amri: maamar liknot, uvia liknot. umiddemaamar la mahane — bia name la mahneya, veate lemival achar bia.
Umay tama amur rabbanan bia pesula yesh achareha kelum —
Amri: i bia achar hagget hi — gezera bia achar hagget mishshum bia achar chalitza. vei bia achar maamar hi — gezera bia achar maamar mishshum bia achar bia.
Umay tama amur rabbanan hay chalitza pesula — en achareha kelum, amri: may ligzor? nigzor chalitza achar hagget mishshum chalitza achar chalitza — kol ki hane tichlotz vetezil.
Ligzor chalitza achar maamar mishshum chalitza achar bia, attu chalitza achar maamar mi la baaya get lemaamaro? chalitza achar bia name baaya get leviato.
Amar rava:

a: May tama derabban gamliel — dimsappeka leh get i dache i la dache. maamar — i kane i la kane. get — i dache i la dache. i kamma dache — batra may kaaved. i kamma la dache — batra name la dache.
Maamar i kane i la kane, i kamma kane — batra may kaaved, vei kamma la kane — batra name la kane.
Etiveh abbaye: umode rabban gamliel sheyyesh get achar maamar, umaamar achar hagget. veget achar bia umaamar, umaamar achar bia veget.
Vei mesappeka leh lerabban gamliel — tihve kevia dilchattechilla, vetikne. deha tenan: habbeila, bizman shehi battechilla — en achareha kelum.

Ella amar abbaye, leolam peshita leh lerabban gamliel beget dedache umaamar dekane. mihu, amur rabbanan: ha yevama — bechad tzad mahane ba get, uvechad tzad mahane ba maamar. get achar get la dache — deha decha leh kamma. umaamar achar maamar la kane — deha kena leh kamma. get achar maamar umaamar achar hagget, hay milleta ka dache vehay milleta ka kane.
Verabbanan: kol chad vechad takkinu le rabbanan get umaamar bivama.

Vehay bia pesula — adifa mimmaamar ugeria mimmaamar. adifa mimmaamar: deillu maamar achar maamar la mahane, veillu bia achar maamar mahane. ugeria mimmaamar: deillu maamar achar hagget kane lechulleh shiyyura deget, veillu bia achar hagget la kanya leh lechulleh shiyyura deget.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad amar rabban gamliel en get achar get? shete yevamot shennaflu lifne yavam echad, venatan get lazo veget lazo. rabban gamliel omer: choletz larishona veasur bikrovoteha, umuttar bikrovot sheniyya.
Vachachamim omrim: natan get lazo veget lazo — asur bikrovot shetehen, vachalitza leachat mehen. vechen atta omer bishne yevamim vivama achat.

Ketzad amar rabban gamliel en maamar achar maamar? shete yevamot shennaflu lifne yavam echad, veasa maamar bazo umaamar bazo, rabban gamliel omer: noten get larishona vecholetz lah, veasur bikrovoteha, umuttar bikrovot sheniyya. vachachamim omrim: noten get lishtehen, veasur bikrovot shetehen, vachalitza leachat mehen. vechen atta omer bishne yevamim vivama achat.

Amar mar: noten get lazo veget lazo, rabban gamliel omer: choletz lerishona veasur bikrovoteha, umuttar bikrovot sheniyya. lema tehve teyuveta dishmuel, deamar shemuel: chalatz levaalat hagget — lo niftera tzara!
Amar lecha shemuel: ki amari ana, allibba deman deamar yesh zikka. verabban gamliel savar en zikka,
Umidderabban gamliel savar en zikka,
b: Rabbanan savri yesh zikka, vekatane sefa: vechen atta omer bishne yevamin vivama achat. lema tehve teyuveta derabba bar rav huna amar rav. deamar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: chalitza pesula — tzericha lachazor al kol haachin.
Amar lach rabba bar rav huna: ben lerabban gamliel ben lerabbanan savri en zikka, vehacha beget achar get umaamar achar maamar kamippalgi.

Amar mar: asa maamar bazo umaamar bazo, rabban gamliel omer: noten get larishona vecholetz lah, veasur bikrovoteha, umuttar bikrovot sheniyya. mikkede kasavar rabban gamliel en maamar achar maamar, rishona name tityaybem? gezera dilma ate leyaybome lishniyya.
Amar rabbi yochanan: rabban gamliel uvet shammay verabbi shimon uven azzay verabbi nechemya — kullehu sevira lehu maamar kone kinyan gamur. rabban gamliel — ha daamaran.

Bet shammay — ditnan: shelosha achin, shenayim mehem nesuin lishte achayot, veechad mufene, met echad mibbaale achayot, veasa bah mufene maamar, veachar kach met achiv hashsheni, bet shammay omrim: ishto immo, vehallezu — tetze mishshum achot ishsha.

Rabbi shimon — detanya: amar lehu rabbi shimon lachachamim: im biat rishon bia — biat sheni enah bia. im biat rishon enah bia — biat sheni name enah bia. veha biat ben tesha, dichmaamar shavveyuha rabbanan, vekaamar rabbi shimon enah bia.

Ben azzay — detanya, ben azzay omer: yesh maamar achar maamar bishne yevamin vivama achat, veen maamar achar maamar bishte yevamot veyavam echad. rabbi nechemya — ditnan, rabbi nechemya omer: achat beila, veachat chalitza, ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof — en achareha kelum. veha bia pesula, dichmaamar shavveyuha rabbanan, vekatane: en achareha kelum.
Ketzad? asa maamar kulei.

a: Hay get achar get hu? amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: get achar hagget, umaamar achar maamar — kedaamaran, yavam echad vivama achat ketzad hattaratan? asa maamar bivimto venatan lah get — tzericha hemennu chalitza.
Asa maamar uvaal — hare zo kemitzvatah. lema mesayyay leh lerav huna, deamar rav huna: mitzvat yevama — mekaddesh veachar kach boel. ema: af ze kemitzvatah.
Peshita! salka datach amena: kevan deamar mar haose maamar bivimto — parcha hemennu zikkat yevamin, vechala alav zikkat erusin venissuin, ema lav mitzva kaaved, ka mashma lan.
Gufa, amar rav huna: mitzvat yevamin — mekaddesh veachar kach boel, veim baal veasa maamar — kana. im baal veasa maamar — peshita, deha kanya bevia! ella ema: im baal belo maamar — kana.
Vehatanya loke! makkat mardut midderabbanan.
Derav menagged man dimkaddesh bevia, uman dimkaddesh beshuka, uman dimkaddesh bela shidduche.
Uman dimvattel gitta, uman demasar modaa aggitta.
[Demitpakkar bishlucha] derabbanan, uman di[m]shahe shamta derabbanan aleh telatin yomin, vela ate leve dina vetava leshamteh.
Veal chatna dedaer beve chamuhi. dedaer — in, dechalef — la? veha hahu dachalef abbava deve chamuhi, venaggedeh rav sheshet! hahu medam hava dayim mechamateh.
Nehardae amri: bechullehu la menagged rav, ella limkaddesh bevia uvela shidduche. veikka deamri: afillu beshidduche name mishshum peritzuta.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad maamar? natan lah kesef o shave kesef. uvishtar ketzad? bishtar ketzad?! kedaamaran: katav lah al hanneyayr o al hacheres, af al pi sheen bo shave peruta: "hare at mekuddeshet li"! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: shetar ketubbat yevamin ketzad?

Katav la: "ana peloni bar peloni kabbelit yat pelonit yevimti alay, lazun ulefarnesah karauy, uvilvad shettehe ketubbatah al nichse balah harishon". vei let la merishon — takkinu la rabbanan mishsheni, kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah.

Bea minneh abbaye merabba: natan lah get, veamar: "hare at megoreshet hemenni, vei at mutteret lechol adam". mahu? get yevama derabbanan hu, get demahane beeshet ish — mahane bivama, get dela mahane beeshet ish — la mahane bivama, o dilma ate leichallofe begitta.

[Amar leh: chayyshinan dilma ate leichallofe begitta.] matkef la rabba bar chanan: ella meatta, yahev la neyayra bealma — hachi name defasla? amar leh: hatam la pasel bichhunna, hacha kafasel bichhunna,
Detanya: "veishsha gerusha meishah lo yikkachu", afillu lo nitgarsha ella meishah — "lo yikkachu", vehayeynu reach hagget shepposel bichhunna.
Amar rame bar chama: hare amru, amar echad lelavlar: ketov get laarusati, lichsheechnesenna agarshenna — hare ze get, mippene shebbeyado legarshah.
b: Uleishsha bealma — en get, mippene sheen beyado legarshah. bae rame bar chama: livimto, mahu? kevan daagida beh — kaarusato damya, o dilma: kevan dela avad ba maamar — la? teku.

Bae rav chananya: katav get lezikkato velo lemaamaro, lemaamaro velo lezikkato, mahu? maamar illave zika ka reme, vehave leh kimgaresh chatzi ishsha, vehamegaresh chatzi ishsha lo asa velo chelum, o dilma: hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae.
Vetifshot leh midderava, deamar rava: natan get lemaamaro — huttera tzaratah! lerava peshita leh, lerav chananya mibbaya leh, may — teku.
Chalatz veasa maamar. amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi akiva, deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin. aval chachamim omrim: yesh achar chalitza kelum.
Umi matzet mokmat la kerabbi akiva, veha katane resha: natan get veasa maamar — tzericha get vachalitza. vei rabbi akiva, kevan dihav lah get, mi mahane ba maamar?
Vehatanya, rabbi akiva omer: minnayin lenoten get livimto shenneesra alav olamit — shenneemar: "lo yuchal balah harishon asher shillechah" — achar shilluach.
Amar rav ashe: get yevamin midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.

Tanya name hachi, amar rabbi: en haddevarim hallalu amurim ella ledivre rabbi akiva, shehaya ose chalutza keerva. aval chachamim omrim: yesh achar chalitza kelum. vaani omer: ematay — bizman shekkiddeshah leshum ishut, aval kiddeshah leshum yavmut — en achar chalitza kelum.

Tanya iddach: hacholetz livimto vechazar vekiddeshah, rabbi omer: im kiddeshah leshum ishut — tzericha hemennu get, leshum yavmut — en tzericha hemennu get. vachachamim omrim: ben shekkiddeshah leshum ishut, bin shekkiddeshah leshum yavmut — tzericha hemennu get.
Amar rav yosef: may tama derabbi — asauha keoder benichse hagger uchesavur shello hen, dela kane.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam la ka mechavven lemikne, hacha ka mechavven lemikne! ha la damya ella leoder benichse ger ze uchesavur shel ger acher hu, dekane.

Ella amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan, kegon daamar la: hitkaddeshi li bemaamar yevamin. rabbi savar: maamar illave zika ka rame, vaatay chalitza afkata lezikkah. verabbanan savri: hay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae. meikkara illu amar la "hitkaddeshi li bemaamar yevamin", mi la mahane? hasheta name mahane.
Rava amar: i deamar la "bemaamar yevamin", kulle alma la peligi demahneya. vehacha bemay askinan — kegon deamar la "hitkaddeshi li bezikkat yevamin". rabbi savar:

a: Yesh zika, vaatay chalitza afkatay lezikka. verabbanan savri: en zikka. meikkara illu amar la: "hitkaddeshi li bezikkat yevamin", mi la mahane? hasheta name mahane.

Rav sherevya amar: bachalitza keshera, i deamar la "hitkaddeshi li bezikkat yevamin" — kulle alma la peligi dela mahane. vehacha bachalitza pesula kamippalgi: mar savar chalitza pesula poteret, umar savar chalitza pesula enah poteret.
Rav ashe amar: dechulle alma chalitza pesula enah poteret, vehacha beyesh tenay bachalitza kamippalgi: mar savar yesh tenay bachalitza, umar savar en tenay bachalitza.
Ravina amar: dechulle alma yesh tenay bachalitza, vehacha bitnay kaful kamippalgi: mar savar baenan tenay kaful, umar savar la baenan tenay kaful.
Chaletz veasa maamar venatan get uvaal vechulei. venitne name en achar bia kelum? abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: tane en achar bia kelum. vetanna didan? hattarat yevama lashshuk adifa leh.

Echad yevama achat, echad shete yevamot. matnitin dela keven azzay, detanya, ben azzay omer: yesh maamar achar maamar bishne yevamin vivama achat, veen maamar achar maamar bishte yevamot veyavam echad.
Ketzad — maamar lazo vechulei. lema mesayyay leh lishmuel, deamar shemuel: chalatz levaalat maamar — lo niftera tzaratah.
Uteyuveta derav yosef: mi katane "choletz"? "chalatz" katane, diavad.
Get lazo veget lazo kulei. lema mesayyay leh lerabba bar rav huna, deamar rabba bar rav huna: chalitza pesula — tzericha lechazzer al kol haachin. may tzerichot — tzerichot dealma.
Get lazo vechalatz lezo. lema mesayyay leh lishmuel, vetihve teyuveta derav yosef! mi katane "choletz"? "chalatz" katane, diavad.
Chalatz vechalatz o chalatz vechulei. velitne name en achar bia kelum! abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: tane en achar bia kelum. vetanna didan — hattarat yevama lashshuk adifa leh.
Ben yavam echad lishte yevamot kulei. bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar kulle beta belav kae — itzterich leashmoinan deen kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin.
Ella leresh lakish, deamar kulle beta becharet kae — itzterich leashmoinan deen kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve karetot!
Amar lach resh lakish: velitamaych, sefa dekatane baal veasa maamar — itzterich leashmoinan deen kiddushin tofsin beeshet ish?
Ella: ayyeyde ditna hattarat yavam echad vivama achat, tena name shete yevamot veyavam echad. veayyeyde ditna shete yevamot veyavam echad, tena name shete yevamin vivama achat.
b: Chalatz veasa maamar venatan vechulei. bishlama chalatz veasa maamar, itzterich, salka datach amena: nigzor maamar devatar chalitza attu maamar dekamme chalitza, ka mashma lan dela gazrinan. ella chalatz venatan get lema li?

Uletamaych, ema sefa: baal veasa maamar, baal venatan get — bishlama baal venatan get itzterich, salka datach amena: nigzor get devatar beila attu get dekamme beila, ka mashma lan dela gazrinan, aval baal veasa maamar lema li?
Ella: ayyeyde ditna chalatz veasa maamar, tena name baal veasa maamar. veayyeyde devae lemitne baal venatan get, tena name chalatz venatan get.

Bizman shehi vechulei. matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya: abba yose ben yochanan ish yerushalayim omer mishshum rabbi meir: achat beila veachat chalitza, battechilla — en achareha kelum, baemtza uvassof — yesh achareha kelum.
Veshalosh machlokot baddavar, tanna kamma savar: bia, deikka lemigzar — gazrinan. chalitza, delekka lemigzar — la gazrinan.

Verabbi nechemya savar: bia name lekka lemigzar, udekaamrat ligzor bia achar hagget mishshum bia achar chalitza — kevan dachalitza deorayyta, midda yadi. udekaamrat ligzor bia achar maamar mishshum bia achar bia — kevan devia deorayyta, ha midda yedii. veabba yose ben chanan savar la kerabbanan degazri bevia, vegazar chalitza mishshum bia.
Hadaran alach rabban gamliel

Habba al yevimto, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon, afillu hu shogeg vehi mezida, hu mezid vehi shogeget, hu anus vehi lo anusa, hi anusa vehu lo anus. echad hameare veechad haggomer — kana. velo chillek ben bia levia.

Vechen habba al achat mikkol haarayot shebbattora, o pesulot, kegon almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin pesalah — velo chillek ben bia levia.
Gemara may "afillu"?

La mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya hu shogeg vehi kamikkavvevna lemitzva, i name hu mezid vehi kamikkavvevna lemitzva, ella afillu hu shogeg vehi mezida, detarvayyhu la kamikkavvevni leshem mitzva — afillu hachi kana. tane rabbi chiyyay: afillu shenehem shoggim, shenehem mezidim, shenehem anusim.
Anus dematnitin hechi dame? illema kesheanasuhu goyim uva aleha, vehaamar rava: en ones leerva! lefi sheen kishshuy ella ledaat.
Ella beyashen. vehaamar rav yehuda:

a: Yashen lo kana bivimto. ella benitka — veha amar rabba: nafal min haggag venitka — chayyayv bearbaa devarim, uvivimto lo kana.
Ella kegon shennitkavvevn leishto, utekafattu yevimto, uva aleha. shenehem anusim deve rabbi chiyyay hechi dame? kegon shennitkavvevn leishto, utekafuhu goyim vedibbekum ze baze, uva aleha.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva. davar acher: "yevamah yavo aleha" — ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon.
Veha appekteh lemitzva? lemitzva mivveim lo yachpotz haish" nafka, ha chafetz — yibbem, vechi ata kera: ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon.

Tanya iddach: "yevamah yavo aleha", kedarkah. "ulekachah" — shello "kedarkah". "veyibbem" — bia gomeret bah, veen kesef ushetar gomrin bah. "veyibbemah" — beal korchah. davar acher: "yevamah yavo aleha", ben beshogeg kulei.
Veha appekteh lichdarkah! hahu — millehakim leachiv shem" nafka, bemakom shemmekim shem. vechi ata kera, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon.
Gufa, amar rav yehuda: yashen — lo kana bivimto, deamar kera: "yevamah yavo aleha", ad dimchavven la leshem bia. vehatanya: ben er [ben yashen! ema: ben era ben yeshena.

Vehatanya: ben er] hu ben yashen hu, ben era hi ben yeshena hi! hacha bemay askinan — bemitnamnem. hechi dame mitnamnem? amar rav ashe: nim vela nim tir vela tir, kegon dekaru leh veane, vela yada leahdore sevara, vechi madkeru leh middechar.

Gufa, amar rabba: nafal min haggag venitka — chayyayv bearbaa devarim, uvivimto lo kana. benezek, betzaar, beshevet, berippuy. aval boshet la michayyayv, deamar mar: en chayyayv al habboshet ad sheyyitkavvevn.
Amar rava: nitkavvevn lehatiach bakkotel vehetiach bivimto — lo kana. lehatiach bivhema vehetiach bivama — kana, deha kamchavven leshem bia beolam.
Echad hameare. amar ulla: minnayin lehaaraa min hattora, shenneemar: "veish asher yishkav et ishsha dava vegilla et ervatah et mekorah heera", mikkan lehaaraa min hattora.
Ashkechan nidda, shear arayot minnayin? vechi tema: nelaf minnidda — ma lenidda shekken metammea et boalah!
Ella atya meeshet ach, dichtiv: "veish asher yikkach et eshet achiv nidda hi" — vechi eshet achiv [leolam] nidda hi? ella kenidda: ma nidda behaaraa — af eshet ach behaaraa.
Ma leeshet ach — shekken beyado lerabbot, dei bae mekaddesh veazel ki alpa.
Ella atya meachot av vaachot em, dichtiv: "veervat achot immecha vaachot avicha lo tegalle ki et sheero heera". ikka lemifrach: ma laachot av vaachot em — shekken issur habba meelav.
Mechada la atya, tete [chada] mittarte. mehe tete? tete meeshet ach vaachot av vaachot em — ma lehanach shekken asurin mishshum sheer.
Ella tete minnidda vaachot av vaachot em. ma lehanach shekken issur habba meelav. ella tete minnidda veeshet ach, demay parchat.
Matkef la rav acha bereh derav ika: ma lenidda veeshet ach, shekken en lahem hetter bechayye osran, tomar beeshet ish, shekken yesh lah hetter bechayye osrah!
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: attu nidda veeshet ach bechayye osran hu deen lahem hetter, aval leachar mikkan yesh lahem hetter? nidda —
b: Beyome talya milleta. eshet ach — bevanim tela rachamana.
Ella parech hachi: ma lenidda veeshet ach shekken en osran mattiran. tomar beeshet ish sheosrah mattirah!

Ella amar rabbi yona, veittema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, amar kera: "ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu hannefashot haosot" — hukkeshu kol haarayot kullan lenidda: ma nidda behaaraa, af kol behaaraa.

Veella "nidda" dichtiva gabbe eshet ach lema li? lechidrav huna. deamar rav huna: remez livama min hattora minnayin, minnayin?! ha ketiv: "yevamah yavo aleha"! ella: remez livama sheasura bechayye balah minnayin?
Hay sevara hi: middeamar rachamana leachar mitat balah sharya, mikkelal divchayye balah asura!
Vedilma: leachar mitat balah mitzva, bechayye balah reshut? i name: leachar mitat balah in, bechayye balah la, velav habba mikkelal ase — ase,

Amar kera: "veish asher yikkach et eshet achiv nidda hi", vechi eshet achiv nidda hi? ella kenidda: ma nidda, af al pi sheyyesh lah hetter leachar mikkan — bishat issurah becharet, af eshet ach [name], af al pi sheyyesh lah hetter leachar mikkan — bechayye balah becharet.
Ella: haaraa dichtiva gabbe achot av vaachot em, lema li?
Lichdiva minneh ravina merava: hameare bizchur mahu? bizchur — "mishkeve ishsha" ketiva!
Ella: hameare bivhema, mahu? amar leh: im eno inyan lehaaraa, dichtiva gabbe achot av vaachot em, deatya behekkesha midderabbi yona, tenehu inyan lehaaraa divhema.
Mikkede behema chayyayve mitot bet din hi, may tama ketiv lehaaraa dida gabbe chayyayve karetot? lichtov gabbe mitat bet din, venelaf mitat bet din mimmitat bet din!
Ayyeyde dechulleh kera lidrasha ate, ketiv beh name ha milleta lidrasha.
May derasha? detanya: "ervat achot avicha lo tegalle", ben min haav, ben min haem. atta omer ben min haav ben min haem, o eno ella min haav velo min haem —
Vedin hu: chayyayv kan vechayyayv baachoto, ma achoto — ben min haav ben min haem, af kan — ben min haav ben min haem.
O kelach lederech zo: chayyayv kan vechayyayv bedodato, ma dodato — min haav velo min haem, af kan — min haav velo min haem,
Nire lemi dome? danin issur habba meelav meissur habba meelav, veal tochiach dodato, sheen issur habba meelav.
O kelach lederech ze: danin kerove haav mikkerove haav, veal tochiach achoto shekkerove atzmo —
Talmud lomar: "ervat achot avicha lo tegalle" — ben min haav ben min haem. "ervat achot immecha lo tegalle" — ben min haav ben min haem.
Lema li lemichtav baachot av, lema li lemichtav baachot em? amar rabbi avahu: tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana baachot av, shekken yesh lah chayis, aval achot em — ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana baachot em — shekken vaddait, aval achot av — ema la, tzericha.
Vedodato, difshita leh letanna demin haav velo min haem, mena leh?
Amar rava: atya "dodo" "dodo". ketiv hacha: "ervat dodo gilla", uchetiv hatam: "o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu", ma lehallan — min haav velo min haem, af kan — min haav velo min haem.
Vehatam menalan? amar kera: "mimmishpachto yigalennu", mishpachat av keruya mishpacha, mishpachat em enah keruya mishpacha.
Vehaditnan: amru lo meta ishtecha venasa achotah meaviha, meta venasa achotah meimmah, meta venasa achotah meaviha, meta venasa achotah meimmah —
Muttar barishona uvashshelishit uvachamishit, ufotrot tzarotehen. veasur bashsheniyya uvarviit, veen biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah.
Veim ba al hashsheniyya leachar mitat harishona, muttar bashsheniyya uvarviit, ufotrot tzarotehen, veasur bashshelishit uvachamishit.

a: Alma achot ishto, ben min haav ben min haem — asurot. menalan? yalef meachoto. ma achoto — ben min haav ben min haem, af kan — ben min haav ben min haem.
Velelaf middodato: ma dodato min haav velo min haem, af kan min haav velo min haem! mistabbera meachoto hava leh lemelaf, shekken kerove atzmo mikkerove atzmo.
Adderabba middodato hava leh lemelaf, shekken davar al yede kiddushin middavar sheal yede kiddushin. ella meeshet ach yalfinan, deshekken davar al yede kiddushin, ukerove atzmo.
Veeshet ach gufa mena lan? detanya: "ervat eshet achicha lo tegalle", ben min haav ben min haem.
Atta omer ben min haav ben min haem, o eno ella min haav velo min haem? vedin hu: chayyayv kan, vechayyayv baachoto. ma achoto — ben min haav ben min haem, af kan — ben min haav ben min haem.
O kelach lederech zo: chayyayv kan vechayyayv bedodato, ma dodato — min haav velo min haem, af kan — min haav velo min haem?!

Nire lemi dome: danin kerove atzmo mikkerove atzmo, veal tochiach dodato shekkerove haav. o kelach lederech zo: danin davar sheal yede kiddushin, middavar sheal yede kiddushin, veal tochiach achoto, sheissur habba meelav.
Talmud lomar: "ervat achicha hi", ben min haav ben min haem.
Veema idde veidde beeshet ach min haav, chada deyesh lah banim bechayye balah, vachada deen lah banim bechayye balah! en lah banim bechayye balah midderav huna nafka.
Veema idde veidde beeshet ach min haav, chada deyesh lah banim bechayye balah, vachada deyesh lah banim leachar mitat balah!
Yesh lah banim leachar mitat balah la tzericha kera, middeamar rachamana sheen lah banim mutteret, ha yesh lah banim asura.
Vedilma: en lah banim asura lealma vesharya leyavam, yesh lah banim sharya lealma vesharya leyavam! i name: en lah banim mitzva, yesh lah banim reshut!
I name: en lah banim — in, yesh lah banim — la, velav habba mikkelal ase — ase!
Ketav kera acharina: "ervat achiv gilla".
Veema eshet ach min haem — keeshet ach min haav: ma eshet ach min haav — leachar mitat balah sharya, af eshet ach min haem — leachar mitat balah sharya! amar kera "hi", bahavayaytah tehe.
Achoto dichtav bah karet lema li?
Lechidrabbi yochanan: deamar rabbi yochanan sheim asaan kullam behelem achat — chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Ulerabbi yitzchak deamar: kol chayyayve karetot bakkelal hayu, velamma yatzta karet baachoto — leduno becharet velo bemalkot. lechallek, menalan?
Nafka leh mivveel ishsha beniddat tumeatah", lechayyev al kol ishsha veishsha.
Dodato dichtav ba rachamana "aririm yihyu", lema li? lechidrabba. derabba rame, ketiv: "aririm yihyu", uchetiv: "aririm yamutu", ha ketzad? yesh lo banim — kovran, en lo banim — holech ariri.

Veitzterich lemichtav "aririm yihyu", veitzterich lemichtav "aririm yamutu", dei ketav rachamana "aririm yihyu", hava amena: ad chiteh, aval mechiteh veelach — la. ketav rachamana "aririm yamutu", vei ketav rachamana "aririm yamutu", hava amena: mechiteh veelach, aval meikkara — la, tzericha.
Haaraa dechayyayve lavin, menalan?
Middegalli rachamana "shichvat zera" gabbe shifcha charufa. mikkelal dechayyayve lavin — behaaraa.
Adderabba: middegalli rachamana haaraa bechayyayve karetot, mikkelal dechayyayve lavin bigmar bia! amar rav ashe: im ken — lishtok kera mishshifcha charufa.
Haaraa dechayyayve lavin dichhunna menalan? atya "kicha" "kicha".
Dechayyayve ase menalan?
b: Atya "bia" "bia".
Yevama lashshuk, menalan? i leman deamar lav — lav, i leman deamar ase — ase.
Ella: yevama leyavam menalan? atya "bia" "bia".
Ishsha levalah menalan? atya "kicha" "kicha".
Amar rava: lema li dichtav rachamana "shichvat zera" beshifcha charufa, "shichvat zera" beeshet ish, "shichvat zera" besota?
Deshifcha charufa — kedaamaran. deeshet ish perat limshammesh met.

Hanicha leman deamar meshammesh met baarayot patur, ella leman deamar chayyayv, may ikka lememar? ella: perat limshammesh meta. desalka datach amena [hoil] leachar mita name ikkeray "sheero", ema lichayyayv ala beeshet ish, ka mashma lan.
Desota lema li? lechidtanya: "shichvat zara", perat ledavar acher. may "davar acher"? amar rav sheshet: perat leshekkinne lah shello kedarkah. amar leh rava: "mishkeve ishsha" ketiv!
Ella amar rava: perat leshekkinne lah derech evarim. amar leh abbaye: peritzuta asar rachamana?
Ella amar abbaye: perat leshekkinne lah binshika. hanicha leman deamar haaraa zo hachenasat atara. ella leman deamar zo neshika, may ikka lememar?
Ella, leolam leshekkinne lah derech evarim, veitzterich, salka datach amena: bikfeda devaal tela rachamana, veha ka kafed, ka mashma lan.
Amar shemuel: haaraa zo neshika. mashal leadam shemmanniach etzbao al piv, i efshar shello yidchok habbasar.

Ki ata rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: gemar bia beshifcha charufa zo hachenasat atara. metiv rav sheshet: "shichvat zera", eno chayyayv ella al biat hammeruk. may lav — meruk gid?! la, meruk atara.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan haaraa zo hachenasat atara. amaru leh: veha rabba bar bar chana la amar hachi! amar lehu: o ihu shakray o ana shakray.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: haaraa zo hachenasat atara. adderabba bar bar chana vadday pelig. addishmuel mi lema pelig?
Lo, minneshika vead hachenasat atara — haaraa kare la.
Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rabbi yochanan: haaraa zo hachenasat atara, gemar bia — gemar bia mammash.

a: Mikkan veelach — eno ella neshika, ufatur aleha. ufelig addishmuel.
Echad hameare veechad haggomer — kana. may kana? rav amar: kana lakkol, ushemuel amar: lo kana ella lidvarim haamurim bapparasha: lirash benichse echav, ulefotrah min hayyibbum.
Min hannissuin — ledivre hakkol achla, deha havat kaachla meikkara. ki peligi min haerusin. rav amar: ochelet, deha rabbi rachamana biat shogeg kemezid.
Ushemuel amar: ki rabbi rachamana, leokmeh bimkom baal, leallome mibbaal — la.
Veazda shemuel letameh, deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: kol shehabbaal maachil — yavam maachil, vechol sheen habbaal maachil — yavam eno maachil.

Metivi: bat yisrael pikkachat shennitarsa lechohen pikkeach, velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh — enah ochelet. met, venafla lifne yavam cheresh — ochelet, uvazo yafe koach hayyavam mikkoach habbaal.
Bishlama lerav nicha — ella lishmuel kashya!
Amar lecha shemuel, ema hachi: velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh — enah ochelet bitruma, kanas veachar kach nitcharesh — ochelet. met venafla lifne yavam cheresh — ochelet.
Umay "bazo"? deillu baal cheresh meikkara — lo ochelet. veillu yavam cheresh meikkara — achla.
Veikka deamri: min haerusin — divre hakkol la achla, deha la achla bechayye vaal.
Ki peligi min hannissuin. rav amar: ochelet, deha havat achla meikkara, ushemuel amar: enah ochelet, ki rabbi rachamana biat shogeg kemezid — lidvarim haamurim bapparasha, aval lechol mille — la.
Vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel: kol shehabbaal maachil — yavam maachil! ema: kol bia shehabbaal maachil bah — yavam maachil bah, vechol bia sheen habbaal maachil bah — en hayyavam maachil bah.

Metivi: bat yisrael pikkachat shennitarsa lechohen pikkeach, velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh — enah ochelet. met, venafla lifne yavam cheresh — ochelet. uvazo yafe koach yavam mikkoach baal. bishlama lerav — metaretz kidtaretz meikkara. ella lishmuel kashya! kashya.

Tanu rabbanan: bat yisrael pikkachat shennitarsa lechohen pikkeach, velo hispik lechonsah ad shennitcharesh — enah ochelet. nolad lah ben — ochelet. met habben, rabbi natan omer: ochelet, vachachamim omrim: enah ochelet.

May tama derabbi natan? amar rabba: hoil shekkevar achla. amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umit leh, techol, shekkevar achla! ella kevan demit leh, pekaa leh kedusheteh minna. hacha name: kevan demit leh, pekaa kedusheteh minna!
Ella amar rav yosef: kasavar rabbi natan nissue cheresh maachilin bitruma, vela gazrinan nissue cheresh attu kiddushe cheresh. amar leh abbaye: i hachi, nolad lah ben lema li? mishshum rabbanan.
Veliflog rabbi natan alayyhu beresha! shavek lehu lerabbanan ad dimsayyeymi milletayyhu vahadar pelig alayyhu. i hachi, litne: met habben enah ochelet, rabbi natan omer: ochelet! kashya.
Vechen habba al achat mikkol haarayot. amar rav amram: ha milleta amar lan rav sheshet,
b: Veanharinhu leayynin mimmatnitin: eshet yisrael shenneensa, af al pi shemmutteret levalah — pesula lichhunna. vetanna tuna: vechen habba al achat mikkol haarayot haamurot betora, o pesulot.
May "vechen"? may lav: la shena beshogeg, vela shena bemezid, vela shena beones, vela shena beratzon, vekatane: pesalah.
La. may "vechen" — ahaaraa. haaraa deman, ilema daarayot — lememra daarayot yalfinan miyyevama? adderabba: yevama yalfinan mearayot, deikkar haaraa baarayot ketiv!
Ella, may "vechen"? ashshello kedarkah daarayot. adderabba: ikkar "mishkeve ishsha" baarayot ketiv!
Ella, may "vechen"? ashshello kedarkah dechayyayve lavin.
Amar rava: eshet kohen shenneensa, balah — loke aleha mishshum zona. mishshum zona in, mishshum tumea la? ema af mishshum zona.
Metiv rabbi zera: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret. veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shennitpasa — asura, vee zo — zo eshet kohen.
Velav habba mikkelal ase, ase!
Amar rabba: hakkol hayu bichlal zona, keshepparat lecha hakkatuv gabbe eshet yisrael "vehi lo nitpasa" asura, ha nitpasa mutteret — mikkelal deeshet kohen kidkayyma kayyma.
Veikka deamri, amar rabba: eshet kohen shenneensa — balah loke aleha mishshum tumea. mishshum tumea — in, mishshum zona — la, alma beones la karena bay zona.
Metiv rabbi zera: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret. veyesh lecha acheret, sheaf al pi shennitpasa — asura, veezo — zo eshet kohen, velav habba mikkelal ase, ase!
Amar rava: hakkol hayu bichlal "achare asher huttammaa", keshepparat lecha hakkatuv gabbe eshet yisrael "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret, mikkelal deeshet kohen kidkayyma — kayyma.
Mishna almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, min haerusin — lo yochlu bitruma. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin.
Nitarmelu o nitgarshu, min hannissuin — pesulot, min haerusin — kesherot.
Gemara tanya, amar rabbi meir: kal vachomer, uma kiddushe reshut — en maachilin, kiddushe avera — lo kol shekken?!
Amru lo: lo. im amarta bekiddushe reshut shekken en lo lehaachil bemakom acher, tomar bekiddushe avera, shekken yesh lo lehaachil bemakom acher.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: petzua dakka kohen shekkiddesh bat yisrael, banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbi elazar verabbi shimon.
Lerabbi meir, deamar mishtammeret levia pesula deorayyta la achla — ha name la achla. lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon, deamri mishtammeret levia pesula deorayyta achla —

a: Ha name achla. mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamri rabbi elazar verabbi shimon hatam, ella deyesh lo lehaachil bemakom acher. aval hacha, deen lo lehaachil bemakom acher — la.
Vechi tema: hacha name yesh lo lehaachil bevat gerim, veha mibbaya bea la rabbi yochanan merabbi oshaya, vela peshayt leh.
Ittemar, abbaye amar: hoil umaachilah belo yedaah.
Rava amar: hoil umaachilah baavadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim.
Abbaye la amar kerava — kinyan deishut mikkinyan deishut yalfinan, vela yalfinan kinyan deishut mikkinyan daavadim.

Verava la amar keabbayye — shane hatam, shekkevar achla. veabbaye: shekkevar achla la amrinan, dei la tema hachi, bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umit — techol, shekkevar achla. verava: hatam paka kinyaneh, hacha la paka kinyaneh.

Gufa, bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi oshaya: petzua dakka kohen shennasa bat gerim. mahu sheyyaachilenna bitruma? ishtik vela amar leh vela midde. lesof ata gavra rabba acharina uvea minneh milleta [achrita] ufeshat leh. umannu — resh lakish. amar leh rabbi yehuda nesia lerabbi oshaya: attu rabbi yochanan lav gavra rabba hu? amar leh: dekavae minnay milleta delet la patri.
Leman? i lerabbi yehuda, ben bikdusheteh kae ben lav bikdusheteh kae — la achla. i bikdusheteh kae — la achla, deha amar mar: bat ger zachar kevat chalal zachar.
I lav bikdusheteh kae — la achla, deha amrinan: kehal gerim ikkeri kahal.

Vei lerabbi yose, ben bikdusheteh kae ben lav bikdusheteh kae — achla. bikdusheteh kae — achla, deha amar: af ger shennasa giyyoret — bitto keshera lichhunna. i lav bikdusheteh kae — achla, deha amar: kehal gerim la ikkeri kahal.
Ella allibba dehay tanna: ditnan, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ishsha bat gerim lo tinnase lichhunna ad shettehe immah miyyisrael.
Vehachi kamibbaya leh: kashrut mittosfa ba — veachla, o dilma kedushsha mittosfa ba — vela achla.

Ta shema: ki ata rabbi acha bar chinnana middaroma, ata veayyti matnita bideh: minnayin liftzua dakka kohen shennasa bat gerim shemmaachilah bitruma, shenneemar: "vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo vegomer yochal bo".

Leman? ilema lerabbi yehuda, haamar: ben bikdusheteh kae ben lav bikdusheteh kae — la achla. vei lerabbi yose — lema li kera, haamar: ben bikdusheteh kae ben lav bikdusheteh kae — achla! ella lav, lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, ushema minna kashrut ittosafa ba veachla. shema minna.
Ittemar, rav amar:
b: Yesh chuppa lifsulot. ushemuel amar: en chuppa lifsulot.
Amar shemuel: umode li abba betinoket pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad, hoil veen lah bia, en lah chuppa.

Amar rava, af anan name tenena: bat shalosh shanim veyom echad mitkaddeshet bevia, veim ba aleha yavam — kenaah, vechayyayvin aleha mishshum eshet ish, umetammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton keelyon.
Nisset lechohen — ochelet bitruma. ba aleha echad mikkol happesulin — pesalah.
Bat shalosh shanim veyom echad, hu demippasla bevia — mippasla bechuppa. ha pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad, dela mippasla bevia — la mippasla name bechuppa. shema minna.
Amar rame bar chama: yesh chuppa lifsulot — banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbi elazar verabbi shimon.

a: Lerabbi meir, deamar kiddushin pasli — chuppa name pasla. lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon, deamri kiddushin la pasli — chuppa name la pasla.
Umimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella bekiddushin, dekane la, aval chuppa dela kane la — la.
I name: ad kan la kaamri rabbi elazar verabbi shimon hatam ella bekiddushin, dela kerivi levia, aval chuppa dikriva levia — hachi name defasla.
Ella i ikka lememar, biflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: nisseu zo vazo, kesherot ufesulot, o shennichnesu lechuppa velo nivalu — ochlot mishshello, veochlot bitruma.
Nichnesu, mikkelal denisseu" — nisseu mammash?!
Ella lav: kegon shennichnesu lechuppa velo nivalu. vekatane: ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma.
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: kol shebbiatah maachilatah — chuppatah maachilatah, vechol sheen biatah maachilatah — en chuppatah maachilatah.
Mimmay? dilma rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka kerabbi meir sevira leh, deamar kiddushin la achla?
Hay "kol sheen biatah maachilatah en chuppatah maachilatah", "kol sheen biatah maachilatah en kaspah maachilatah" mibbee leh! dilma, ayyeyde deamar tanna kamma chuppa, amar ihu name chuppa.
Amar rav amram: ha milleta amar lan rav sheshet, veanharinhu leayynin mimmatnitin: yesh chuppa lifsulot. vetanna tuna: amen shello satiti arusa unesua, shomeret yavam uchenusa.
Hay arusa hechi dame? illema dekanni la keshehi arusa veka mashke la keshehi arusa — arusa bat mishteya hi? veha tenan: arusa veshomeret yavam — lo shotot velo notlot ketuva!

Ella dekanni la keshehi arusa veistetar, vekamashke la keshehi nesua, mi badki la mayya? vehatanya: "venikka haish meavon", bizman shehaish menukke meavon — hammayim bodkin et ishto, en haish menukke meavon — en hammayim bodkin et ishto.
Ella, dekanni lah keshehi arusa, veistetar, venichnesa lechuppa velo nivala — ushema minna yesh chuppa lifsulot.

Amar rava: vetisbera deha metaratzta hi? veha ki ata rabbi acha bar chanina middaroma, ata veayyti matnita bideh: "mibbalade ishech", mi shekkadma shechivat baal labboel, velo shekkadma shechivat boel labbaal.
Amar rame bar chama: mashkachat la kegon shebba aleha arusah bevet aviha.
Dichvota gabbe shomeret yavam — shebba aleha yavam bevet chamiha,
b: Shomeret yavam karet la? ishto mealleya hi, deha amar rav: kana lakkol! kishmuel, deamar: lo kana ella lidvarim haamurim bapparasha.
Midde hu tama ella lerav. ha amar rav: kana lakkol. hacha bemay askinan — kegon daavad ba maamar, uvet shammay hi, deamri: maamar kone kinyan gamur.
I hachi — hayeynu arusa? uletamaych, nesua uchenusa lav chada milleta hi?! ella: nesua dideh, uchenusa dechavreh. hacha name: arusa dideh, veshomeret yavam dechavreh.
Rav pappa amar: hay tanna hu, detanya: en mekannin lah laarusa lehashekotah keshehi arusa, aval mekannin otah lehashekotah keshehi nesua.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: al yede gilgul.
Shelach rav chanina mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: haose maamar bivimto [veyesh lo ach], afillu hu kohen vehi kohenet — pesalah min hatteruma.

Leman? illema lerabbi meir — emar deamar rabbi meir mishtammeret levia pesula la achla middeorayyta, derabbanan mi amar? veella lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon. hasheta mishtammeret levia pesula deorayyta achla — derabbanan mibbaya?!

Ella, ki ata ravin, amar: asa bah maamar bivimto — divre hakkol achla, yesh lo ach chalal — divre hakkol enah ochelet. lo nechleku ella shennatan lah get. rabbi yochanan amar: ochelet. resh lakish amar: enah ochelet.
Rabbi yochanan amar ochelet — afillu lerabbi meir deamar enah ochelet, hane mille mishtammeret levia pesula deorayyta, aval derabbanan — achla.
Veresh lakish amar enah ochelet — afillu lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon deamri ochelet, hane mille deyesh lo lehaachil bemakom acher, aval hacha, kevan deen lo lehaachil bemakom acher — la.
Vechi tema: hacha name yesh lo lehaachilah bechozeret — chozeret paska minneh, ukerova leve nasha, aval ha agida beh.
Nitarmelu o nitgarshu vechulei. bea minneh rabbi chiyyay bar yosef mishshemuel: kohen gadol shekkiddesh et hakketanna uvagra tachtav,

a: Mahu? batar nissuin azlinan, o batar erusin azlinan.
Amar leh, tenetuha: nitarmelu o nitgarshu, min hannissuin — pesulot, min haerusin — kesherot.
Amar leh: leshauoye chalala la kamibbaya li, devia hi dimshavvevya chalala. ki kamibbaya li: "vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach", may? kicha dekiddushin baenan, o kicha denissuin baenan.
Amar leh, ha name tenetuha: eras et haalmana venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol — yichnos. shane hatam, dichtiv: "yikkach ishsha".
Hacha name, ketiv "ishsha"! achat velo shetayim.
Uma raita? ha — ishtanni gufa, veha — la ishtanni gufa.
Mishna kohen gadol lo yissa almana, ben almana min haerusin, ben almana min hannissuin. velo yissa et habbogeret. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret [velo yissa et mukkat etz].

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "almana ... lo yikkach" — ben almana min haerusin, ben almana min hannissuin. peshita! mahu detema: lelaf "almana" "almana" mittamar, ma lehallan min hannissuin — af kan min hannissuin, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name?! dumeya digrusha: ma gerusha — ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin, af almana — ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin.
Velo yissa et habbogeret. tanu rabbanan: "vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach", perat labbogeret — shekkalu lah betuleha. divre rabbi meir. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi meir savar: "betula" — afillu miktzat betulim mashma. "betuleha" — ad deikka kol habbetulim. "bivtuleha", bichdarkah — in, shello kedarkah — la.
Verabbi elazar verabbi shimon savri: "betula" — betula shelema mashma. "betuleha" — vaafillu miktzat betulim. "bivtuleha" — ad sheyyihyu kol betuleha kayyaymin, ben bichdarkah, ben shello kedarkah.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: nivala shello kedarkah — pesula lakkehunna. metiv rava: "velo tihye leishsha" — beishsha haruya lo, perat lealmana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot.
Hechi dame? illema bichdarkah, may irya mishshum almana? tippok leh mishshum dehavya la beula, ella lav: shello kedarkah, umishshum almana — in, mishshum beula — la!
b: Ha manni — rabbi meir hi, verav deamar kerabbi elazar.
I kerabbi elazar, may irya mishshum beula? tippok leh dehavya la zona! deha amar rabbi elazar: panuy habba al happenuya shello leshem ishut — asaah zona.
Amar rav yosef: kegon shennivala livhema, dehatam mishshum beula ikka, mishshum zona lekka.

Amar leh abbaye, mimma nafshach: i beula havya — zona name havya. vei zona la havya — beula name la havya. vechi tema: mide dehave amukkat etz shello kedarkah, im ken, en lecha ishsha shekkeshera lakkehunna, shello naaset mukkat etz al yede tzeror.
Ella, amar rabbi zera: bimmaenet.
Amar rav shimi bar chiyyay: nivala livhema — keshera lakkehunna. tanya name hachi: nivala lemi sheeno ish, af al pi shebbiskila — keshera lakkehunna.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: maase beriva achat behayetalo shehayta mechabbedet et habbayit, urevaah kelev kuferi meachareha, vehichshirah rabbi lakkehunna. amar shemuel: ulechohen gadol. bime rabbi kohen gadol mi hava? ella — reuya lechohen gadol.
Amar leh rava mipparzakya lerav ashe: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan en zenut livhema? dichtiv: "lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev".
Utenan: etnan kelev umechir zona — muttarin, (mishshum) shenneemar: "gam shenehem" — shenayim velo arbaa.

Tanu rabbanan: anusat atzmo umefuttat atzmo — lo yissa, veim nasa — nasuy. anusat chavero umefuttat chavero — lo yissa, veim nasa, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: havvalad chalal, vachachamim omrim: havvalad kasher.
Im nasa — nasuy, amar rav huna amar rav: umotzi beget. veella ha dekatane: im nasa nasuy! amar rav acha bar yaakov: lomar

a: Sheen meshallem kenas bimfutta.
Azal rav geviha mibbe chatil, amra lishmata kammeh derav ashe. amar leh: veha rav verabbi yochanan deamri tarvayyhu: bogeret umukkat etz — lo yissa, veim nasa — nasuy.
Alma: sofah lihyot bogeret tachtav, sofah lihyot mukkat etz tachtav. hacha name: sofah lihyot beula tachtav. kashya.

Anusat chavero umefuttat chavero — lo yissa. veim nasa — rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: havvalad chalal, vachachamim omrim: havvalad kasher. amar rav huna amar rav: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. vechen amar rav giddel amar rav: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Ikka deamri, amar rav huna amar rav: may tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov — savar la kerabbi elazar.
Umi savar la kevateh? veha kayyma lan: mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kav venaki. veillu beha amar rav amram amar rav: en halacha kerabbi elazar. kashya.
Rav ashe amar: beyesh chalal mechayyayve ase kamippalgi. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: yesh chalal mechayyayve ase, verabbanan savri: en chalal mechayyayve ase.
May tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov — dichtiv: "almana ugerusha vachalala zona et elle lo yikkach ki im betula vegomer", uchetiv: "velo yechallel zaro beammav", akkullehu.
Verabbanan: "elle" hifsik hainyan. verabbi eliezer ben yaakov amar: "elle" lemaote nidda.
Keman azla ha detanya: meelle" atta ose chalal, vei atta ose chalal minnidda. keman — kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. verabbi eliezer ben yaakov, nichteveh leelle" levassof? kashya.

Tanu rabbanan: achoto arusa, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim: mittamme lah. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: en mittamme lah. anusa umefutta — divre hakkol en mittamme lah. umukkat etz — en mittamme lah, divre rabbi shimon. shehaya rabbi shimon omer: reuya lechohen gadol — mittamme lah, sheen reuya lechohen gadol — en mittamme lah.
Uvogeret — mittamme lah, divre kol adam.
May tama derabbi meir verabbi yehuda — dedarshi hachi: "velaachoto habbetula" — perat laanusa umefutta.

Yachol sheani motzi af mukkat etz — talmud lomar: "asher lo hayta leish". mi shehavayaytah al yede ish, yatza zo sheen havayaytah al yede ish. "hakkerova" — lerabbot haarusa. "elav" — lerabbot habbogeret.
Ha lema li kera? vehaamar rabbi meir: "betula" — afillu miktzat betula mashma! itzterich, salka datach amena nelaf "betula" "betula" mehatam: ma lehallan naara, af kan name naara, ka mashma lan.

Verabbi yose verabbi shimon, may tamayyhu — darshi hachi: "velaachoto habbetula" — perat laanusa umefutta umukkat etz, "asher lo hayta" — perat laarusa, "hakkerova" — lerabbot arusa shennitgarsha, "elav" — lerabbot et habbogeret. "hakkerova" — lerabbot arusa shennitgarsha,
b: Veha amar rabbi shimon: reuya lechohen gadol — mittamme lah, sheen reuya lechohen gadol — en mittamme lah. shane hatam, derabbi rachamana "kerova".
I hachi, mukkat etz name! [rabbi] "kerova" — achat velo shetayim. uma raita? ha — itavid ba maase, ha — la itavid ba maase.
Verabbi yose, middeshavkeh levar zugeh, mikkelal divmukkat etz kerabbi meir sevira leh, mena leh — millo hayta leish".
Veha appekteh! chad millo hayta", vechad milleish".

"Elav" — lerabbot habbogeret. veha amar rabbi shimon: "betula" — betula shelema mashma! tama dideh name hatam mehacha, dedaresh hachi middeelav" — lerabbot habbogeret, michlal divtula" — betula shelema mashma.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad — keshera lakkehunna, shenneemar: "vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar hachayu lachem", vahare pinchas immahem.
Verabbanan? laavadim velishfachot. i hachi, bat shalosh shanim veyom echad name?

Kidrav huna. derav huna rame, ketiv: "kol ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu", ha enah yodaat — kayyemu, mikkelal dehattaf, ben yadu ben lo yadu — kayyemu. uchetiv: "vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar hachayu lachem", ha yadi — harogu!
Heve omer biruya libbael hakkatuv medabber.

Tanya name hachi: "vechol ishsha yodaat ish" — biruya libbael hakkatuv medabber. atta omer biruya libbael, o eno ella nivala mammash? keshehu omer: "vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo yadu mishkav zachar", heve omer: biruya libbael hakkatuv medabber.

Mena yadi? amar rav huna bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: heevirum lifne hatztzitz. kol sheppaneha morikot — beyadua shehi reuya libbael, kol sheen paneha morikot — beyadua sheenah reuya libbael. amar rav nachman: siman laavera — hidrokan.

Kayyotze baddavar, atta omer: "vayyimtzeu miyyoshve yavesh gilad arba meot naara vetula asher lo yadu ish lemishkav zachar", mena yadi? amar rav kahana: hoshivum al pi chavit shel yayin, beula — rechah nodef, betula — en rechah nodef.

Uneabberinhu lifne tzitz? amar rav kahana bereh derav natan: "leratzon lahem" ketiv, leratzon velo lefureanut. i hachi bemidyan name? amar rav ashe: "lahem" ketiv, lahem — leratzon velo lefureanut, ulegoyim — afillu lefureanut.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon ben yochay. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi: beferush shemia lach, o mikkelala shemia lach?

May kelala? deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ir achat hayta beeretz yisrael shekkara aleha arar, veshigger rabbi et rabbi romanus uvedakah, umatza bah bat giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad, vehichshirah rabbi lakkehunna. amar leh: beferush shemia li.
Vei mikkelala may? dilma shane hatam: hoil veinnesiv — innesiv. deha rav verabbi yochanan deamri tarvayyhu: bogeret umukkat etz lo yissa, veim nasa — nasuy.
Hachi hasheta?! bishlama hatam: sofah lihyot bogeret tachtav, sofah lihyot beula tachtav. hacha, sofah lihyot zona tachtav?!
Rav safra matne la mikkelala vekashya leh, umeshanne (leh) hachi.

Hahu kahana deinnesiv giyyoret pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak: may hay? amar leh, deamar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi shimon ben yochay. amar leh: zil appek, vei la — mappekna lach rabbi yaakov bar idi meunnach.
Tanya, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer:

a: Kivre goyim enan metammein beohel, shenneemar: "veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem". attem keruyin adam, veen haggoyim keruyin adam.
Metivi: "venefesh adam shishsha asar alef"! mishshum behema.
"Asher yesh bah harebe mishtem esre ribbo adam asher lo yada ben yemino lismolo (uvehema rabba)"! mishshum behema.
"Kol horeg nefesh vechol nogea bechalal titchatteu"! dilma ikketil chad miyyisrael. verabbanan: "lo nifkad mimmennu ish". verabbi shimon ben yochay: "lo nifkad mimmennu ish" — laavera.
Ravina amar: nehi demaatinhu kera meittammoye beohel, dichtiv: "adam ki yamut beohel", mimmagga umassa mi maatinhu kera?

Mishna eras et haalmana venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol — yichnos. umaase bihoshua ben gamla shekkiddesh et marta bat baytos, uminnahu hammelech lihyot kohen gadol, uchenasah. shomeret yavam shennafla lifne kohen hedyot, venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol, af al pi sheasa bah maamar — hare ze lo yichnos.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim eras et haalmana venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol sheyyichnos — talmud lomar: "yikkach ishsha". i hachi, shomeret yavam name! "ishsha", velo yevama.

Maase bihoshua vechulei. minnahu — in, nitmanna — la. amar rav yosef: ketir kachazena hacha. deamar rav assi: tarkabba dedinare ayyilah leh marta bat baytos leyannay malka ad demoke leh lihoshua ben gamla bechahane ravreve.
Mishna kohen gadol shemmet achiv — choletz velo meyaybem.
Gemara ka pasek vetane, la shena min haerusin vela shena min hannissuin. bishlama min hannissuin, ase velo taase hu, veen ase doche lo taase vaase. ella min haerusin, yavo ase veyidche et lo taase?!
Gezera bia rishona attu bia sheniyya.

Mishna kohen hedyot lo yissa aylonit, ella im ken yesh lo ishsha uvanim. rabbi yehuda omer: af al pi sheyyesh lo ishsha uvanim lo yissa aylonit, shehi zona haamura battora. vachachamim omrim: en zona ella giyyoret umeshuchereret veshennivala beilat zenut.

Gemara amar leh resh galuta lerav huna: may tama — mishshum periyya ureviyya, apperiyya ureviyya kohanim hu demippakkedi veyisrael la mippakkedi?! amar leh: mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa, rabbi yehuda omer: af al pi sheyyesh lo ishsha
b: Veyesh lo banim — lo yissa aylonit, shehi zona haamura battora. deazzona kohanim hu demippakdi veyisrael la mippakkedi, mishshum hachi katane kohen.
Amar rav huna: may tama derabbi yehuda, dichtiv: "achlu velo yisbau hiznu velo yifrotzu", kol bia sheen bah pirtza — enah ella beilat zenut.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: kohen lo yissa et hakketanna. amar leh rav chisda lerabba: pok ayyen bah, dilureta bae la rav huna minnach. nefak ayyen bah: rabbi eliezer savar la kerabbi meir, vesavar la kerabbi yehuda.
Savar la kerabbi meir, dechayesh lemiuta. vesavar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: aylonit zona havya.

Ucherabbi meir mi savar la? vehatanya: katan uketanna lo choltzin velo meyabbemin, divre rabbi meir. amru lo lerabbi meir: yafe amarta sheen choltzin. "ish" ketiv bapparasha, umakkeshinan ishsha leish. ella may tama en meyabbemin?
[Amar lahem:] katan — shemma yimmatze saris, ketanna — shemma timmatze aylonit, venimtzeu pogin beerva. vetanya: ketanna mityaybemet veenah choletzet, divre rabbi eliezer.

Ucherabbi yehuda mi savar la? vehatanya: "zona" — zona kishmah, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer: "zona" zo mufekeret. rabbi matya ben charash omer: afillu halach balah lehashekotah, uva aleha badderech — asaah zona.
Rabbi yehuda omer: zona — zo aylonit. vachachamim omrim: en zona ella giyyoret umeshuchereret veshennivala beilat zenut. rabbi elazar omer: panuy habba al happenuya shello leshem ishut — asaah zona.
Ella amar rav adda bar ahava: hacha bechohen gadol askinan. leemat kane la, lechi gadla [lechi gadla] — beula hi.
Amar rava: mechalle lev, i dekaddesha avu — mehahi shata hu dekane la. vei dekaddisha nafsha — ha rabbi eliezer hi vela rabbanan?
Ella amar rava: leolam bechohen hedyot — vechayyshinan shemma titpatte alav. i hachi yisrael name! pittuyy ketanna ones hu, veones beyisrael mishra shere.

Rav pappa amar: bechohen gadol, vehay tanna hu detanya: "betula", yachol ketanna — talmud lomar: "ishsha". i ishsha, yachol bogeret — talmud lomar: "betula". ha ketzad? yatzta mikkelal katnut, velichlal bagrut lo bata.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: hay tanna hu detanya: "betula", en betula ella naara. vechen hu omer: "vehannaara tovat mare meod betula".
Rabbi elazar omer: panuy habba al happenuya shello leshem ishut — asaah zona. amar rav amram: en halacha kerabbi elazar.
Mishna lo yibbatel adam mipperiyya ureviyya ella im ken yesh lo banim. bet shammay omrim: shene zecharim, uvet hillel omrim: zachar unekeva, shenneemar: "zachar unekeva beraam".

Gemara ha yesh lo banim — mipperiyya ureviyya batel, meishsha la batel. mesayyeya leh lerav nachman amar shemuel. deamar: af al pi sheyyesh lo leadam kamma banim, asur laamod belo ishsha, shenneemar: "lo tov heyot haadam levaddo".

Veikka deamri: ha yesh lo banim — batel mipperiyya ureviyya, uvatel name meishsha. nema tehve teyuveta derav nachman amar shemuel! la: en lo banim — nose ishsha bat banim, yesh lo banim — nose ishsha delav bat banim. nafka minna limkor sefer tora bishvil banim.

Bet shammay omrim: shene zecharim. may tamayyhu devet shammay? yalfinan mimmoshe, dichtiv: "bene moshe gershom veeliezer". uvet hillel: yalfinan mibberiyyayto shel olam. uvet shammay, lelfe mibberiyyayto shel olam? en danin efshar

a: Mishshei efshar. uvet hillel name, lelfu mimmoshe! amri lach: moshe middateh hu daavad. detanya: shelosha devarim asa moshe middato, vehiskima dato ledaat hammakom: perash min haishsha, veshibber halluchot, vehosif yom echad.

Perash min haishsha, may derash? amar: uma yisrael, shello dibbera immahem shechina ella lefi shaa, vekava lahem zeman, amra tora: "al tiggeshu el ishsha" — ani, shemmeyuchad ledibbur bechol shaa veshaa, velo kava li zeman — al achat kamma vechamma. vehiskima dato ledaat hammakom, shenneemar: "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem. veatta po amod immadi".

Shibber et halluchot, may derash? amar: uma pesach, shehu echad mishshesh meot ushelosh esre mitzvot, amra tora "kol ben nechar lo yochal bo". hattora kullah, veyisrael meshummadim — al achat kamma vechamma.
Vehiskima dato ledaat hammakom, dichtiv: "asher shibbarta", veamar resh lakish: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta.

Hosif yom echad middato, may derash? dichtiv: "vekiddashtam hayyom umachar". hayyom kemachar: ma machar lelo immo, af hayyom lelo immo. velayla dehaiddana nefak leh, shema minna tere yome levar mehaiddana. vehiskima dato ledaat hammakom — dela sharya shechina ad shabbeta.
Tanya, rabbi natan omer: bet shammay omrim: shene zecharim ushete nekevot, uvet hillel omrim: zachar unekeva.

Amar rav huna: may tama derabbi natan allibba devet shammay? dichtiv: "vattosef laledet et achiv et havel": hevel vaachoto, kayin vaachoto, uchetiv: "ki shat li elohim zera acher tachat hevel ki harago kayin". verabbanan? odoye hu deka modya.

Tanya iddach, rabbi natan omer: bet shammay omrim: zachar unekeva, uvet hillel omrim: o zachar o nekeva. amar rava: may tama derabbi natan allibba devet hillel, shenneemar: "lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah", veha avad la shevet.

Ittemar: hayu lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer, rabbi yochanan amar: kiyyem periyya ureviyya. veresh lakish amar: lo kiyyem periyya ureviyya. rabbi yochanan amar: kiyyem periyya ureviyya — deha havo leh. veresh lakish amar: lo kiyyem periyya ureviyya — ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame.

Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: hayu lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer, rabbi yochanan amar: en lo bechor lenachala, deha hava leh "reshit ono". veresh lakish amar: yesh lo bechor lenachala, ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame.

Utzericha: dei ashmeinan behahi kammayyta, behahi kaamar rabbi yochanan — mishshum demeikkara name bene periyya ureviyya ninhu, aval leinyan nachala, delav bene nachala ninhu — ema mode leh leresh lakish.
Vei ittemar beha — beha kaamar resh lakish, aval behahi — ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan, tzericha.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: "baet hahi shalach berodach baladan ben baladan melech bavel vegomer"! amar leh begayyutan — it lehu chayis, nitgayyeyru — let lehu chayis.

Amar rav: hakkol modin beeved sheen lo chayis, dichtiv: "shevu lachem po im hachamor": am haddome lachamor. metivi: "uletziva chamishsha asar banim veesrim avadim"! amar rav acha bar yaakov: kefar ben bakar".

I hachi, hacha name! shane hatam, deyachasinhu bishmayyhu uvishma daavuhon, vehacha la mefaresh. veibbaet ema: yachasinhu beducheta achariti baavuhon uveabba daavuhon, dichtiv: "vayyishlachem hammelech asa el ben hadad ben tavrimmon ben chezyon melech aram hayyoshev bedammesek lemor".
Ittemar: hayu lo banim umetu, rav huna amar: kiyyem periyya ureviyya. rabbi yochanan amar: lo kiyyem.

Rav huna amar: kiyyem — mishshum derav assi. deamar rav assi: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol neshamot shebbagguf, shenneemar: "ki ruach millefanay yaatof vegomer", verabbi yochanan amar: lo kiyyem periyya ureviyya — "lashevet yetzarah" baenan, veha lekka.
Metivi:
b: Bene vanim hare hen kevanim! ki tanya hahi, lehashelim.
Metivi: bene vanim hare hem kevanim, met echad mehem o shennimtza saris — lo kiyyem periyya ureviyya. teyuveta derav huna teyuveta.
Bene vanim hare hem kevanim. sevar abbaye lememar, bera livra uveratta livratta, vechol shekken bera livratta. aval beratta livra — la. amar leh rava: "lashevet yetzarah" baaya, veha ikka.
Dechulle alma mihat tere mechad la. vela? veha amri leh rabbanan lerav sheshet: nesev itteta veoled bene, vaamar lehu: bene veratti — bene ninhu!
Hatam dachoye kamdache lehu, derav sheshet iakar mippirkeh derav huna.

Amar leh rabba lerava bar mari: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan bene vanim hare hen kevanim? illema middichtiv "habbanot benotay vehabbanim banay", ella meatta: "vehatztzon tzoni" hachi name?! ella diknet minnay, hacha name — diknet minnay.
Ella mehacha: "veachar ba chetzron el bat machir avi gilad vatteled lo et seguv", uchetiv: "minni machir yardu mechokkim", uchetiv "yehuda mechokki".

Matnitin delav kerabbi yehoshua, detanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: nasa adam ishsha beyalduto — yissa ishsha beziknuto. hayu lo banim beyalduto — yihyu lo banim beziknuto, shenneemar: "babboker zera et zarecha velaerev al tannach yadecha ki encha yodea e ze yichshar haze o ze veim shenehem keechad tovim".

Rabbi akiva omer: lamad tora beyalduto — yilmod tora beziknuto. hayu lo talmidim beyalduto — yihyu lo talmidim beziknuto, shenneemar: "babboker zera et zarecha vegomer". amru: shenem asar alef zugim talmidim hayu lo lerabbi akiva miggevat ad antifras, vechullan metu beferek echad, mippene shello nahagu kavod ze laze.

Vehaya haolam shamem, ad shebba rabbi akiva etzel rabbotenu shebbaddarom ushenaah lahem: rabbi meir, verabbi yehuda, verabbi yose, verabbi shimon, verabbi elazar ben shammua, vehem hem heemidu tora otah shaa.
Tana, kullam metu mippesach vead atzeret. amar rav chama bar abba veittema rabbi chiyyay bar avin: kullam metu mita raa. may hi? amar rav nachman: askara.
Amar rav matna: halacha kerabbi yehoshua.

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi chanilay: kol adam sheen lo ishsha — sharuy belo simcha, belo beracha, belo tova. belo simcha, dichtiv: "vesamachta atta uvetecha". belo beracha, dichtiv: "lehaniach beracha el betecha". belo tova, dichtiv: "lo tov heyot haadam levaddo".
Bemareva amri: belo tora, belo choma. belo tora, dichtiv: "haim en ezrati vi vetushiyya niddecha mimmenni". belo choma, dichtiv: "nekeva tesovev gaver".
Rava bar ulla amar: belo shalom, dichtiv: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha ufakadta navcha velo techeta".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hayyodea beishto shehi yirat shamayim veeno pokdah — nikra chote, shenneemar: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha vegomer". veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: chayyayv adam lifkod et ishto beshaa shehu yotze ladderech, shenneemar: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha vegomer".
Ha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "veel ishech teshukatech", melammed shehaishsha mishtokeket al balah beshaa shehu yotze lederech! amar rav yosef: lo nitzrecha ella samuch levivstah.
Vechamma? amar rava: ona. vehane mille lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva — mitteridi.

Tanu rabbanan: haohev et ishto kegufo, vehamechabbedah yoter miggufo, vehammadrich banav uvenotav bederech yeshara, vehammassian samuch lefirkan — alav hakkatuv omer: "veyadata ki shalom oholecha". haohev et shechenav, vehamekarev et kerovav, vehannose et bat achoto,

a: Vehammalve sela leani bishat dochko — alav hakkatuv omer: "az tikra vaAdonai yaane teshavva veyomar hinneni".

Siman: ishsha. vekarka. ezer. zot. shete. haverachot. taggare. pachati. amar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheen lo ishsha — eno adam, shenneemar: "zachar unekeva beraam vayyikra et shemam adam". veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheen lo karka — eno adam, shenneemar: "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam".

Veamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv "eese lo ezer kenegdo": zacha — ozarto, lo zacha — kenegdo. veikka deamri: rabbi elazar rame, ketiv "kenaggedo", vekarenan "kenegdo". zacha — kenegdo, lo zacha — menaggadto.

Ashkecheh rabbi yose leeliyyahu, amar leh, ketiv: "eese lo ezer", bamma ishsha ozarto laadam? amar leh: adam mevi chittin — chittin koses? pishtan — pishtan lovesh? lo nimtzet meira enav umaamidato al raglav?!
Veamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv: "zot happaam etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari" — melammed shebba adam al kol behema vechayya, velo nitkarra dato ad shebba al chavva.

Veamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv: "venivrechu vecha kol mishpechot haadama", amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham: shete haverachot tovot yesh li lehaverich becha: rut hammoaviyya, venaama haammonit. "kol mishpechot haadama" — afillu mishpachot haddarot baadama en mitbarchot ella bishvil yisrael. "kol goye haaretz" — afillu sefinot habbaot miggalya leaspamya enan mitbarchot ella bishvil yisrael.

Veamar rabbi elazar: atidim kol baale ummaniyyot sheyyaamdu al hakkarka, shenneemar: "veyardu meoniyyotehem kol tofse mashot mallachim kol chovle hayyam al haaretz yaamodu". veamar rabbi elazar: en lecha ummanut pechuta min hakkarka, shenneemar: "veyardu". rabbi elazar chazya lehahi ara deshade bay kerava lefuteya, amar leh: i tishdeyeh leurekaych — happoche beiska tav minnach.

Rav al levene shuyvle, chazanhu deka nayyfan, amar lehu: i nayyfat — itnofe. happoche beiska tav minnach. amar rava: mea zuze beiska — kol yoma bisra vechamra, mea zuze beara — milcha vachafura. velo od ella magneya leh aara, umarmeya leh tigre.
Amar rav pappa: zera vela tizboyn. af al gav dechi hadade ninhu, hane mibbarchan. zabben vela tizzol. hane mille bistarke, aval gelima — la mitramya leh.
Tum vela teshappetz. shappetz vela tivne. shekkol haosek bevinyan — mitmasken. kefotz zevoyn ara, meton nesev itteta. nechet darga nesev itteta. sak darga bechar shoshvina.
Amar rabbi elazar bar avina: en pureanut baa laolam ella bishvil yisrael, shenneemar: "hichratti goyim nashammu pinnotam hecheravti chutzotam", uchetiv: "amarti ach tiri oti tikchi musar".

Rav hava mippetar merabbi chiyyay, amar leh: rachamana laytztzelach mimmidde dekashe mimmota. umi ikka midde dekashe mimmota? nefak, dak veashkach: "umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha vegomer". rav hava ka metzaara leh devethu, ki amar la "avidi li telofche", avda leh chimtze. "chimtze", avda leh telofche.

Ki gedal chiyyay bereh, afech la. amar leh: iallaya lach immach! amar leh: ana hu deka afechna la. amar leh, hayeynu deka amri inashe: denafek minnach, tama mallefach. at la taaved hachi, shenneemar: "limmedu leshonam dabber sheker haave vegomer".

Rabbi chiyyay hava ka metzaara leh devethu. ki hava mashkach midde, tzayayr leh besudareh umayyte nihala. amar leh rav: veha ka metzaara leh lemar? amar leh: dayyenu shemmegaddelot banenu, umatztzilot otanu
b: Min hachet. makre leh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh "umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha". amar leh: kegon man? kegon immach.

Veha matne leh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh: en adam motze korat ruach ella meishto rishona, shenneemar: "yehi mekorcha varuch usemach meeshet neurecha", vaamar leh: kegon man? kegon immach! mitkayf tekifa, veabbore meyabbera bemilla.
Hechi dame ishsha raa? amar abbaye: mekashsheta leh takka umekashsheta leh pumma. rava amar: mekashsheta leh takka umahdera leh gabba.

Amar rabbi chama bar chanina: kevan shennasa adam ishsha avonotav mitpakkekin, shenneemar: "matza ishsha matza tov vayyafek ratzon meAdonai". bemareva ki nasev inash itteta, amri leh hachi: "matza" o "motze"? "matza" dichtiv: "matza ishsha matza tov", motze dichtiv: "umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha".

Amar rava: ishsha raa mitzva legarshah, dichtiv: "garesh letz veyetze madon veyishbot din vekalon", veamar rava: ishsha raa uchetubbatah merubba — tzaratah betziddah. deamri inashe: bachavirta, vela besilta. veamar rava: kasha ishsha raa keyom sagrir, shenneemar: "delef tored beyom sagrir veeshet midyanim nishtava".

Veamar rava: bo uree kamma tova ishsha tova, vechamma raa ishsha raa. kamma tova ishsha tova, dichtiv: "matza ishsha matza tov", i begavva mishtae kera — kamma tova ishsha tova, shehakkatuv meshabbechah. i battora mishtae kera — kamma tova ishsha tova, shehattora nimshela bah. kamma raa ishsha raa, dichtiv: "umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha". i begavva mishtae kara — kamma raa ishsha raa, shehakkatuv meganneha. i begehinnam mishtae kera — kamma raa ishsha raa, sheggehinnam nimshela bah.

"Hinni mevi raa asher lo yuchelu latzet mimmenna", amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: zo ishsha raa uchetubbatah merubba. "netanani Adonai bide lo uchal kum", amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva bar chiyyay: zo ishsha raa uchetubbatah merubba. bemareva amru: ze shemmezonotav teluyin bechaspo.

"Banecha uvenotecha netunim leam acher", amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: zo eshet haav. "begoy naval achisem", amar rav chanan bar rava amar rav: zo ishsha raa uchetubbatah merubba. rabbi eliezer omer: ellu hamminim. vechen hu omer: "amar naval belibbo en elohim vegomer".

Bematnita tana: ellu anshe barbarya veanshe martenay, shemmehallechin arummim bashshuk. sheen lecha meshukkatz umetoav lifne hammakom yoter mimmi shemmehallech bashshuk arom. rabbi yochanan amar: ellu chabbarim. amaru leh lerabbi yochanan: ato chabbare levavel, shega nefal. amaru leh: mekabbeli shucheda, taretz yetev.
Gazru al shelosha mippene shelosha. gazru al habbasar — mippene hammattanot, gazru al hammerchatzaot — mippene hattevila.

Ka mechatteti shachve — mippene shessemechim beyom edam. shenneemar: "vehayta yad Adonai bachem uvaavotechem". amar rabba bar shemuel: (zo) chattote shachve. deamar mar: baavon chayyim — metim mitchattetin.

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari, ketiv: "lo yeasfu velo yikkaveru ledomen al pene haadama yihyu", uchetiv: "venivchar mavet mechayyim". amar leh: nivchar mavet larshaim, shello yichyu beolam hazze veyechetu, veyippelu begehinnam.

Katuv besefer ben sira: "ishsha tova mattana tova levalah", uchetiv: "tova bechek yere elohim tinnaten". "ishsha raa tzaraat levalah", may takkanteh — "yegarshenna veyitrappe mitztzarato". "ishsha yafe ashre balah, mispar yamav kiflayim".

"Haelem enecha meeshet chen pen tillached bimtzudatah. al tet etzel balah limsoch immo yayin veshechar, ki betoar ishsha yafa rabbim hushechatu, vaatzumim kol harugeha". "rabbim hayu pitze rochel". "hammargilim lidvar erva kenitzotz mavir gachelet. kichluv male of — ken battehem meleim mirma".

"Al tetzar tzarat machar, ki lo teda ma yeled yom. shemma machar ba veenennu, nimtza mitztaer al haolam sheen shello". "mena rabbim mittoch betecha, velo hakkol tavi betecha". "rabbim yihyu dorshe shelomecha. galle sod leechad mealef".

Amar rabbi assi: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol hanneshamot shebbagguf, shenneemar: "ki ruach millefanay yaatof uneshamot ani asiti". tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: kol mi sheen osek bifriyya ureviyya — keillu shofech damim, shenneemar: "shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech", uchetiv batreh: "veattem peru urevu".

Rabbi yaakov omer: keillu memaet haddemut, shenneemar: "ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam", uchetiv batreh: "veattem peru vegomer". ben azzay omer: keillu shofech damim umemaet haddemut, shenneemar: "veattem peru urevu".

Amru lo leven azzay: yesh nae doresh venae mekayyem, nae mekayyem veen nae doresh, veatta nae doresh, veen nae mekayyem. amar lahen ben azzay: uma eese shennafshi chashka battora, efshar laolam sheyyitkayyem al yede acherim.

Tanya iddach, rabbi eliezer omer: kol mi sheen osek bifriyya ureviyya — keillu shofech damim, shenneemar: "shofech dam haadam", usemich leh: "veattem peru vegomer". rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: keillu memaet haddemut. ben azzay omer vechulei. amru lo leven azzay: yesh nae doresh vechulei.
Tanu rabbanan: "uvenucho yomar shuva Adonai rivvot alfe yisrael" —
