a: Melammed sheen hashshechina shora al pachot mishshene alafim ushene revavot miyyisrael. hare shehayu yisrael shene alafim ushene revavot chaser echad, veze lo asak bifriyya ureviyya — lo nimtza ze gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael?!

Abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi eliezer: chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "uvanim lo hayu lahem", ha hayu lahem banim — lo metu. acherim omrim: gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael, shenneemar: "lihyot lecha lelohim ulezaracha acharecha", bizman shezzaracha acharecha — shechina shora, en "zaracha acharecha" — al mi shora? al haetzim veal haavanim?!

Mishna nasa ishsha veshaha immah eser shanim velo yalda — eno rashshay levattel. gershah — mutteret linnase leacher. verashshay hashsheni lishhot immah eser shanim. veim hippila — mone mishshaa shehippila.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: nasa ishsha veshaha immah eser shanim velo yalda — yotzi veyitten ketuva, shemma lo zacha lehibbanot mimmenna.

Af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar: "mikketz eser shanim leshevet avram beeretz kenaan" — lelammedcha sheen yeshivat chutz laaretz ole lo min hamminyan. lefichach, chala hu o shechalta hi, o shenehem chavushim bevet haasurim — en olin lo min hamminyan.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: velelaf miyyitzchak, dichtiv: "vayhi yitzchak ben arbaim shana bekachto et rivka vegomer", uchetiv: "veyitzchak ben shishshim shana beledet otam"! amar leh: yitzchak akur haya.

I hachi, avraham name akur haya! hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nimnu shenotav shel yishmael — kede leyayches bahen shenotav shel yaakov.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: yitzchak avinu akur haya, shenneemar: "vayyetar yitzchak laAdonai lenochach ishto". "al ishto" lo neemar, ella "lenochach", melammed sheshshenehem akurim hayu. i hachi: "vayyeater lo" — "vayyeater lahem" mibbee leh! lefi sheeno dome tefillat tzaddik ben tzaddik litfillat tzaddik ben rasha.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: mippene ma hayu avotenu akurim — mippene shehakkadosh baruch hu mitavve litfillatan shel tzaddikim. amar rabbi yitzchak: lamma nimshela tefillatan shel tzaddikim keeter — ma eter ze mehappech hattevua mimmakom lemakom, kach tefillatan shel tzaddikim mehappechet middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu mimmiddat ragzanut lemiddat rachamanut. amar rabbi amme: avraham vesara tumetmin hayu, shenneemar: "habbitu el tzur
b: Chutztzavtem veel makkevet bor nukkartem", uchetiv, "habbitu el avraham avichem veel sara techolelchem".
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: sara immenu aylonit hayta, shenneemar: "vattehi saray akara en lah valad", afillu bet valad en lah.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: lo shanu ella bedorot harishonim, sheshshenotehen merubbot. aval bedorot haacharonim, sheshshenotehen muatot — shete shanim umechetza, keneged shelosha ibburim. rabba amar rav nachman: shalosh shanim, keneged shalosh pekidot. deamar mar: berosh hashshana nifkedu sara rachel vechanna.
Amar rabba: letanhu lehane kelale. mikkede matnitin man takken — rabbi, veha bime david immaut shene, dichtiv: "yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana".
Vehay "shemma lo zacha lehibbanot hemenna", vedilma ihi dela zachya? ihi kevan dela mefakkeda apperiyya ureviyya, la miansha.

Ini? veha amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi abba bar zavda: nesev itteta veoled bene, vaamar lehu: i zechay — havo li mikkammayyta. hatam dachoye ka medache lehu lerabbanan, derabbi abba bar zavda iakar mippirkeh derav huna.

Rav giddel iakar mippirkeh derav huna. rabbi chelbo iakar mippirkeh derav huna. rav sheshet iakar mippirkeh derav huna. rav acha bar yaakov achadteh susekinta, talyu bearza deve rav unefak minneh kehutza yarka. amar rav acha bar yaakov: shittin save havena vechullehu iakur mippirkeh derav huna levar meana, dekayyemi benafshay "hachochma techayye vealeha".
Gershah mutteret vechulei. sheni — in, shelishi — la.
Matnitin manni? rabbi hi. detanya: mala harishon vamet, sheni vamet, shelishi — lo tamul, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shelishi tamul, revii — lo tamul.
Vehatanya ippecha, he minnayyhu (acharinita)?

Ta shema, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: maase bearba achayot betzippori shemmala rishona vamet, sheniyya vamet, shelishit vamet, reviit bat lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel. amar lah: al tamuli.
Vedilma i atya shelishit name hava amar lah? im ken, may ashaduteh derabbi chiyyay bar abba? vedilma ha ka mashma lan daachayot mechazzekot.
Amar rava: hasheta deamrat achayot mechazzekot, lo yissa adam ishsha lo mimmishpachat nichpin velo mimmishpachat metzoraim. vehu deittachzak telata zimne.

May hava ala? ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar: ovada hava kammeh derabbi yochanan bichnishta demaon beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat, umala rishona vamet, sheniyya vamet, shelishit baa lefanav. amar lah: lechi umuli.
Amar leh abbaye: chazi dekasharet issura vesakkanta.

Semach ala abbaye, vaazal nasva lechuma beratte deisi bereh derav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda, denasva rachava defumebdita ushechev, rav yitzchak bereh derabba bar bar chana ushechev, venasva hu ushechev.

Amar rava: umi ikka deaved ovada benafsheh ki hay, veha ihu deamar: avin — desamcha, yitzchak summaka — lav bar samcha. avin — yeshno bachazara, yitzchak summaka — eno bachazara. veod: emar difligi leinyan mila, benissuin mi peligi?
In, vehatanya: nisset larishon vamet, lashsheni vamet, lashshelishi — lo tinnase, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lashshelishi — tinnase, lirvii — lo tinnase.

Bishlama gabbe mila, ikka mishpacha dirfe dema veikka mishpacha dikmit dema, ella nissuin may tama? amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi amar avimi mehageronya mishshemeh derav huna: mayan gorem. verav ashe amar: mazzal gorem.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deersa umit, i name dinfal middikla umit.
Amar leh rav yosef bereh derava lerava, beay minneh merav yosef: halacha kerabbi? vaamar li: in. halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel? vaamar li: in, achoche achecha bi!
Amar leh: la, setame hi ufeshayt lach: nissuin umalkiyyot — kerabbi. vesatot veshor hammuad — kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Nissuin — ha daamaran. malkiyyot — ditnan: mi shellaka veshana — bet din konsin oto lechippa umaachilin oto seorim ad shettehe kereso nivkaat. vesatot — ditnan: en haishsha

a: Kovaat lah veset, ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim. veen mittaheret min havveset, ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim. veshor hammuad — ditnan: en hashshor naase muad, ad sheyyaidu bo shelosha peamim.
Tanu rabbanan: nisset larishon velo hayu lah banim, lashsheni velo hayu lah banim, lashshelishi lo tinnase ella lemi sheyyesh lo banim. nisset lemi sheen lo banim — tetze belo ketubba.

Ibbaya lehu: nisset lashshelishi velo hayu lah banim, mahu delitbeuha hanach kammae? mi matzu amri la: iggallay milleta deat hu digramt. o dilma matzet amara lehu: hasheta hu dichchashi. mistabbera matzya amara lehu hasheta hu dichchashi.
Ibbaya lehu: nisset larvii vehayu lah banim, mahu detitbeeh lishlishi! amrinan la: shetikutich yafa middibburich. dematze amar la: ana addata dehachi la gareshtich.
Matkef la rav pappa: i ihi shatka, anan mi shatkinan?! nimtza get batel, uvaneha mamzerin! ella amrinan: hasheta hu divriyyayt.
Hu amar minna, vehi amra minneh, amar rabbi amme: devarim shebbeno levenah — neemenet, vetama may? hi (kayyma) [kim] la beyore kechetz, hu la kim leh beyore kechetz.

Amar ihu: ezil innesiv itteta veevdok nafshay. amar rabbi amme: af bazo yotzi veyitten ketubba. sheani omer: kol hannose ishsha al ishto — yotzi veyitten ketubba. rava amar: nose adam kamma nashim al ishto, vehu deit leh lemezayyninhi.
b: Hu amar: appilat bego asar. vehi amra: la appelit. amar rabbi amme: af bezo hi neemenet. deim ita deappila — nafsha beakreta la machzeka.

Hippila, vechazra vehippila, vechazra vehippila — huchezka linfalim. hu amar: appila tere, vehi amra: telat, amar rabbi yitzchak ben elazar: ovada hava be midresha, vaamaru: hi mehemna, deim ita dela appila — nafsha benifle la machzeka.
Mishna haish metzuvvev al periyya ureviyya, aval lo haishsha. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: al shenehem hu omer: "vayvarech otam elohim vayyomer lahem [elohim] peru urevu".
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: amar kera: "umilu et haaretz vechivshuha". ish darko lechabbesh, veen ishsha darkah lechabbesh.
Adderabba: "vechivshuha" tarte mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "vechovsheha" ketiv. rav yosef amar, mehacha: "ani el shadday pere ureve", vela kaamar "peru urevu".

Veamar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: keshem shemmitzva al adam lomar davar hannishma — kach mitzva al adam shello lomar davar sheeno nishma. rabbi abba omer: chova, shenneemar: "al tochach letz pen yisnaekka hochach lechacham veyeehavekka".
Veamar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: muttar lo laadam leshannot bidvar hashshalom, shenneemar: "avich tzivva vegomer ko tomru leyosef anna sa na vegomer".
Rabbi natan omer: mitzva, shenneemar: "vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani vegomer".
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: gadol hashshalom, sheaf hakkadosh baruch hu shinna bo, demeikkara ketiv: "vaadoni zaken", ulevassof, ketiv: "vaani zakanti".
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer. ittemar, rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi, chad amar: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka, vechad amar: en halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka.
Tistayyaym derabbi yochanan hu deamar en halacha: ditev rabbi avahu vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: halacha, veahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayyhu.

Veikka deamri: rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar, veahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayyhu. amar rav pappa: bishlama leman deamar rabbi avahu amra, mishshum kevod be kesar la amru leh vela midde. ella leman deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amra — lemru leh: la amar rabbi yochanan hachi.

May hava ala? ta shema, deamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi assi: ovada hava kammeh derabbi yochanan bichnishta dekesari, vaamar: yotzi veyitten ketubba. vei salka datach la mefakkeda — ketubba may avidta?
Dilma bevaa mechamat taana.
Ki hahi daatay lekammeh derabbi amme. amara leh: hav li ketubba! amar la: zil, la mippakkedat! amara leh: missevu dila may tehve ala dehach itteta? amar: ki ha — vadday kafenan.
Hahi daatay lekammeh derav nachman. amar la: la mippakkedat. amara leh: la baaya hach itteta chutera lida umara likvura? amar: ki ha vadday kafenan.

Yehuda vechizkiyya teomim hayu, echad nigmera tzurato lesof tisha, veechad nigmera tzurato litchillat shiva. yehudit, devethu derabbi chiyyay, hava la tzaar leda. shannay mana, vaatay lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amara: itteta mefakkeda apperiyya ureviyya? amar la: la. azala ishteya samma daakarta.
Lesof iggallay milleta. amar la: ikko yeladt li chada karsa achrita, deamar mar: yehuda vechizkiyya ache, pazzi vetavi

a: Achvota.

Vela mippakdi? vehaamar rav acha bar rav kattina amar rabbi yitzchak: maase beishsha achat shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin, vechafu et rabbah vaasaah bat chorin! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: minhag hefker nahagu bah.
Hadaran alach habba al yevimto
Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, hichnisa lo avde melog veavde tzon barzel, avde melog — lo yochlu bitruma, avde tzon barzel — yochelu.

Veellu hen avde melog: im metu — metu lah, veim hotiru — hotiru lah, af al pi shehu chayyayv bimzonotan hare ellu lo yochlu bitruma. veellu hen avde tzon barzel: im metu — metu lo, veim hotiru — hotiru lo, hoil vehu chayyayv beachrayutan — hare ellu yochlu bitruma.

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehichnisa lo avadim, ben avde melog, ben avde tzon barzel — hare ellu yochlu bitruma. uvat kohen shennisset leyisrael vehichnisa lo avadim, ben avde melog, ben avde tzon barzel — hare ellu lo yochlu bitruma.

Gemara veavde melog lo yochlu bitruma, ammay? leheve kekinyano shekkana kinyan! detanya: minnayin lechohen shennasa ishsha vekana avadim sheyyochlu bitruma, shenneemar: "vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo hu yochal bo".
Uminnayin leishsha shekkanta avadim, vaavadav shekkanu avadim, sheyyochlu bitruma — shenneemar: "vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo hu yochal bo", kinyano shekkana kinyan — ochel.
Kol haochel — maachil, kol sheen ochel — eno maachil.
Vela? vahare arel, vechol hattemeim sheenan ochlin, umaachilin! hatam, pummayyhu kaev lehu.
Vahare mamzer, sheen ochel, umaachil!
Amar ravina: kinyan ochel kaamar, kinyan ochel — maachil, sheeno ochel — eno maachil.
Verava amar: middeorayyta mechol achli, verabbanan hu degazri behu, kede shettomar: ani eni ochelet, avaday enan ochlin — zona hi etzlo?! hilkach ate leappoka.
Rav ashe amar: gezera shemma taachil leachar mita.
Ella meatta, bat yisrael shennisset lechohen lo taachil, gezera shemma taachil leachar mita!

Ella amar rav ashe: bealmana kohenet, deatya leoroye: meikkara achali bitruma deve nasha, innesevi leh lehay — achali bitruma degavray, vehasheta hadari li lemilletay kammayyta. vela yada demeikkara la shavveta lenafsha chalala, hasheta shavveta lenafsha chalala.
Tinach almana kohenet, almana bat yisrael may ikka lememar? bealmenuta la peligi rabbanan.
Ittemar: hammachneset shum levalah, hi omeret: kelay ani notelet, vehu omer: damim ani noten, haddin im mi? rav yehuda amar:
b: Haddin immah, verav amme amar: haddin immo.

Rav yehuda amar haddin immah — mishshum shevach bet aviha dida have. rabbi amme amar: haddin immo — kevan deamar mar: im metu — metu lo, veim hotiru — hotiru lo, hoil vechayyayv beachrayutan — yochelu. amar rav safra: mi katane "vehen shello"? "hoil vechayyayv beachrayutan" katane, uleolam lav dideh ninhu.

Vechol hecha dechayyayv beachrayutan achli bitruma? vehatnan: yisrael shessachar para mikkohen — hare ze yaachilenna karshinne teruma. kohen shessachar para miyyisrael, af al pi shemmezonoteha alav — la yaachilenna karshinne teruma!

Vetisbera? nehi name dimchayyev bigneva vaaveda, beonseha bechachshah uvenifchat dameha — mi michayyayv? ha la damya ella lesefa: yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen, la yaachilenna karshinne teruma. aval kohen sheshsham para miyyisrael — yaachilenna karshinne teruma.

Yatev rabba verav yosef beshilhe pirkeh derav nachman veyatvi vekaamri: tanya kevateh derav yehuda, vetanya kevateh derabbi amme. tanya kevateh derabbi amme: avde tzon barzel yotzin beshen vaayin. laish, aval lo laishsha.

Tanya kevateh derav yehuda: hammachneset shum levalah, im ratza habbaal limkor — lo yimkor. velo od ella afillu hichnis lah shum mishshello, im ratza habbaal limkor — lo yimkor. machru shenehem lefarnasa, ze haya maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel, veamar: habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.

Amar rava amar rav nachman: halacha kerav yehuda. amar leh rava lerav nachman: vehatanya kevateh derabbi amme! af al gav detanya kevateh derabbi amme, mistabbera tama derav yehuda, mishshum shevach bet aviha.
Hahi itteta deayyila leh legavra itztela demelata bichtubbeta. shechev, shakluha yatme ufarsuha ammitana.

Amar rava: kanyay mitana. amar leh nanay bereh derav yosef bereh derava lerav kahana: vehaamar rava amar rav nachman: halacha kerav yehuda? amar leh: mi la mode rav yehuda dimchussar guveyayna. vechevan dimchussar guveyayna — birshuteh kae.
Rava letameh, deamar rava: hekdesh, chametz,

a: Veshichrur — mafkiin mide shibud.
Amar rav yehuda: hichnisa lo shene chelim beelef zuz, veshavchu veamdu al shene alafim. echad notalto bichtubbatah, veechad notenet damim venotalto, mippene shevach bet aviha.
May ka mashma lan — shevach bet aviha dida have? ha amra rav yehuda chada zimna! mahu detema: hane mille hecha dematya lemishkal bichtubbeta, aval mittan deme umishkal — la, ka mashma lan.
Mishna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet, vehinnichah meubberet — lo yochlu avadeha bitruma, mippene chelko shel ubbar, shehaubbar posel. veeno maachil, divre rabbi yose.
Amru lo: meachar sheheadta lanu al bat yisrael lechohen — af bat kohen lechohen umet, vehinnicha meubberet — lo yochlu avadeha bitruma, mippene chelko shel ubbar.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: tama derabbi yose mishshum dekasavar ubbar bime zara — zar hu, o dilma: yalud — maachil, sheeno yalud — eno maachil?
Lemay nafka minna — leubbar bime chohenet, may? amar rabba, hayeynu tama derabbi yose: dekasavar ubbar bime zara zar hu. rav yosef amar: yalud — maachil, sheen yalud — eno maachil.
Metivi, amru lo lerabbi yose: meachar sheheadta lanu al bat yisrael lechohen, bat kohen lechohen mahu? amar lahem: zo shamati vezo lo shamati.
I amrat bishlama: ubbar bime zara zar hu — hayeynu dekaamar lehu: zo shamati vezo lo shamati. ella i amrat: yalud — maachil, sheen yalud — en maachil, may zo shamati vezo lo shamati? ihi hi kashya.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi yose. aval chachamim omrim: yesh lo banim — ochlim mishshum banim. en lo banim — ochlim mishshum achim. en lo achim — ochlim mishshum mishpacha kullah.

"Zo" vela sevira leh. ha amar leh shemuel lerav chana bagdataa: pok ayyti li be asra, deema lach beanpayyhu: hamezakke leubbar — kana. ella: "zo" usevira leh. may ka mashma lan — difligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yose.
Umi peligi? metiv rabbi zakkay: zo edut heid rabbi yose mippi shemaya veavtalyon, vehodu lo! amar rav ashe: mi katane "vekibbelu"? "vehodu lo" katane, demistabbar tameh.

Tanu rabbanan: hinniach banim — ellu vaellu ochlim. hinnichah meubberet — ellu vaellu en ochlim. hinniach banim, vehinnichah meubberet — avde melog ochlim kederech shehi ochelet, avde tzon barzel — lo yochlu, mippene chelko shel ubbar. shehaubbar posel veeno maachil, divre rabbi yose.

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: habbat — maachelet, habben — eno maachil. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: zecharim yochlu kullan, nekevot lo yochelu, shemma yimmatze ubbar zachar, veen labbanot bimkom habben kelum.
May irya shemma yimmatze ubbar zachar? tippok leh dinkeva name pasla! chada veod kaamar: chada, dinkeva name pasla. veod, shemma yimmatze ubbar zachar, veen labbanot bimkom habben kelum.
Zecharim yochelu: vehaikka ubbar! kasavar:
b: En choshshin lemiuta. veibbaet ema: leolam kasavar choshshin lemiuta, deavdinan leh takkanta kerav nachman amar shemuel.

Deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: yetomim shebbau lachalok benichse avihem, bet din maamidin lahem appotroppos, uvorer lahem chelek yafe. higdilu — yecholin lemachot. verav nachman dideh amar: higdilu — en yecholin lemachot, deim ken ma koach bet din yafe.
Lema derav nachman tannae hi? la, dechulle alma it lehu derav nachman. vehacha bechoshshin lemiuta kamippalgi.
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: habbat maachelet, habben eno maachil. may shena ben delo maachil — mishshum chelko shel ubbar? bat name lo taachil — mippene chelko shel ubbar!
Amar abbaye: hacha binchasim muatim askinan. uchegon deikka ben bahade bat,
Ma nafshach: i hay dimabbera ben hu — la adif mehay dekae. i bat hi, ammay achla — betakkanta derabbanan, kamma dela nefak laavir haolam la takkinu rabbanan.
Bemay okemta — binchasim muatim, ema sefa: shemma yimmatze haubbar zachar, veen labbanot bimkom ben kelum. adderabba, nechasim muatim devanot ninhu! sefa atan linchasim merubbin.
Unechasim muatim devanot ninhu? vehaamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: yetomin shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatim — ma shemmachru machru?!
Veella, may "bat" dekatane — em. i hachi, hayeynu rabbi yose? kullah rabbi yishmael berabbi yose katane la.
Mishna haubbar, vehayyavam, vehaerusin, vehacheresh, uven tesha shanim veyom echad — poslin, velo maachilin.
Safek shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad safek sheeno, safek hevi shete searot vesafek shello hevi,
Nafal habbayit alav veal bat achiv, veen yadua e ze met rishon — tzaratah choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Gemara haubbar. i bat kohen leyisrael hi — pasel lah. "kinureha" — perat limubberet. i bat yisrael lechohen hi — lo maachil lah, yalud — maachil, sheeno yalud — eno maachil.
Hayyavam. i bat kohen leyisrael hi — pasel lah. "veshava el bet aviha" — perat leshomeret yavam. i bat yisrael lechohen hi — la maachel lah, "kinyan kaspo" amar rachamana, veha kinyan deachiv hu.
